31792-III.s: This bill amends the 2008 budget statutes of the Ministry of General Affairs, the Royal Cabinet and the Oversight Committee for the intelligence and security services, reflecting the autumn budget review. The changes add funds of EUR 4,359 thousand and EUR 7,495 thousand (in two supplementary budgets) to the Ministry of General Affairs and small amounts to the other two bodies, with the law effective from 1 December 2008.
q: The budget statutes forming part of the national budget are each separately established and therefore also amended by law under Article 1(3) of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001.

De begrotingsstaten die onderdeel uitmaken van de Rijksbegroting, worden op grond van artikel 1, derde lid, van de Comptabiliteitswet 2001 elk afzonderlijk bij de wet vastgesteld en derhalve ook gewijzigd.

31989.s: The bill amends the Childcare Act, the Education Inspection Act and the Primary Education Act to tighten quality requirements for peuterspeelzalen (playgroups) and to make voorschoolse educatie (preschool education) quality conditions enforceable through municipal oversight and Inspectorate supervision. It strengthens municipalities' coordinating role in early-childhood and school-readiness policy, adds a municipal power to impose binding agreements ('doorzettingsmacht') on schools and childcare providers, and lets the government set quality rules by general administrative order (AMvB) if no convenant is reached.
31989.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the AMvB route as a fallback if a convenant between parties cannot be reached or stalls, to guarantee a basic quality level for children.
q: This can be used if no convenant is reached or if the process of amending the convenant reaches or threatens to reach an impasse.
Daarvan kan gebruik worden gemaakt als er geen convenant tot stand komt of het proces van wijziging van het convenant in een impasse komt dan wel dreigt te komen.
d: quality rules for childcare centres (safety, staff qualifications, group size, pedagogy)
quality rules for voorschoolse educatie in childcare centres
quality rules for voorschoolse educatie in peuterspeelzalen
policy rules on application of quality articles
information to be provided on notification, record-keeping, inspection procedure
experiments with innovative peuterspeelzaal work, may deviate from chapter 2
criteria and amount of specific grant to municipalities for educational disadvantage
further conditions on educational disadvantage policy until 2011
municipal agreements on preschool/early-school education with schools and providers
p: Municipal executive may impose binding obligations on schools and childcare providers that refuse to agree on educational disadvantage arrangements (doorzettingsmacht).
II, C / III, L (art. 170 WPO; Wet OT 15i)
Minister of OCW may step in for municipalities that neglect their duties (taakverwaarlozing), bypassing the provincial route.'
I, CC / 1.61; II, B(a); II, D (15g)
Enforcement and oversight of preschool quality is strengthened via GGD and Inspectorate reporting, a reinforcement of checks rather than a shift away from them.

parties: Worries that municipal override power and the one-size-fits-all target group definition could infringe freedom of institution, and questions whether the supervisory structure is too fragmented.
The members are fundamentally very critical of a municipal override power.
De leden staan principieel zeer kritisch tegenover een doorzettingsmacht van de gemeente.
Supports harmonisation but asks for guaranteed multi-year funding, combined inspection and monitoring, and the Inspectorate to examine teacher training quality.
They are strong supporters of far-reaching harmonisation of the legislation for playgroups and childcare centres.
Zij zijn een groot voorstander van verregaande harmonisatie van de wetgeving voor peuterspeelzalen en kindercentra.
Asks why the government did not choose legal mechanisms to directly hold individual municipalities to account, and calls for earmarked funding and a legal basis for quality standards.
The SP members believe the funding stream for educational disadvantage should be earmarked.
De leden van de SP-fractie zijn van mening dat de geldstroom voor onderwijsachterstanden geoormerkt dient te worden.
Asks for justification of the 1.5 multiplier factor and of the funding breakdown, and why no pupil tracking system is introduced.
These members ask for further explanation of how the factor of 1.5 was reached.
Deze leden vragen of nader kan worden toegelicht hoe tot een factor van 1,5 is gekomen.
Stresses protection of freedom of direction and institution for identity-based playgroups and asks how override powers are limited.
These members ask for attention to the necessity of parental involvement in the VVE programme.
De leden vragen aandacht voor de noodzaak van de betrokkenheid van ouders bij het VVE-programma.
Questions the evidence base for VVE effectiveness, the legitimacy of municipal override powers without objective criteria, and expanding the Inspectorate's role before the WOT is revised.
These members ask whether requirements on outcomes will still influence which lesson programmes are permissible.
Deze leden vragen of middels de eisen aan opbrengsten alsnog invloed wordt uitgeoefend op de lesprogramma's die toelaatbaar zijn.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a draft bill amending the Childcare Act, the Education Inspectorate Act and the Primary Education Act to improve early childhood education (VVE) and preschool quality. The government's reply (nader rapport) addresses each point, accepting several remarks (e.g. data-protection, oversight of municipalities) while defending the core design, including the ouderbijdrage and the instruments of the bill.
concerns: The Raad gave numerous redactional comments, which the government largely incorporated.
Data exchange on children's development must comply with the Wbp; the government added the purpose, retention period (two years) and rights, and dropped the persoonsgebonden nummer use.

The Raad doubted that the mandatory agreements on resultaten van vroegschoolse educatie and segregation respect freedom of direction and organisation (art. 23 Grondwet) and school choice; the government clarified the scope and dropped the segregation/admission-procedure element.
The Raad doubted the evidence base for effectiveness of VVE; the government disputed the reading of the research but added explanation and pilot references to the memorie van toelichting.

The Raad questioned whether higher quality requirements could lead to closures or higher parental costs and whether the impacts were proportionate; the government argued the Rijk funds the extra staff costs and refers to additional funding.

The provision allowing the minister to intervene in cases of municipal taakverwaarlozing was premature under the Code Interbestuurlijke Verhoudingen; the government dropped it, leaving the provincial route.
The Raad found unclear whether VVE is education under art. 23 Grondwet or welfare under the Wmo; the government kept the Wpo framework but stressed it is not education in the constitutional sense.
The Raad asked to make quality requirements subject to an AMvB rather than set otherwise; the government adjusted the articles accordingly.

The Raad doubted there would be enough qualified staff in time and asked clarity on training costs and funding; the government explained the funding (about 100 million euro structurally) and a training trajectory, but leaves uncertainty.
The Raad asked to justify the medezeggenschap (parent committee) requirement for private peuterspeelzalen; the government kept it in lighter form for non-subsidised facilities.
The Raad asked to consult the VNG in writing as required by the Code; the government reports the VNG was consulted and reacted by letter.

31998.s: The bill amends the Wet geluidhinder to define international racing circuits (TT-Circuit Assen, Circuit Park Zandvoort, or others designated by ministerial regulation) and to exclude noise from such circuits on up to 12 days per calendar year from the calculation of noise load. It clarifies the existing 12-day regime for large industrial installations so that it applies to these circuits.
31998.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial designation power as a way to cover possible future circuits that acquire a comparable international status, without having to amend the statute again.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel A (definitie internationaal racecircuit)

parties: Supports promoting sport but asks whether competent local authorities should decide when noise nuisance is acceptable and whether other areas could be designated for noisy activities.
Objects that the government leaves noise limits and compensation to the provincial authority and asks whether residents keep appeal rights and whether any noise limits remain.
Does this mean that residents and interested parties retain the possibility, through objection and appeal, to still block international races they do not want?
Betekent dit dat omwonenden en belanghebbenden via bezwaar en beroep de mogelijkheid behouden om de door hen ongewenste internationale races alsnog tegen te kunnen houden?
Asks whether the bill is a clarification or a change and what its practical effects will be.
According to the government, is this a change or merely a clarification, and why?
Is volgens de regering een wijziging of slechts een verduidelijking aan de orde en waarom?
Argues the bill is ad hoc legislation that broadens rather than clarifies the regime, citing the Raad van State advice, and questions its application to industrial estates.
Can the government explain why it keeps the euphemistic label 'clarification of the 12-day regulation', while the Raad van State states the following:
Kan de regering uiteenzetten waarom wordt vastgehouden aan de eufemistische kwalificatie «verduidelijking van de 12-dagenregeling», terwijl de Raad van State het volgende stelt:
Asks about the effects on the circuits' other 353 days and whether a peak noise limit applies outside exemption days.
Is it correct that no maximum noise level (peak noise) applies on these days and that a penalty correction is only applied during UBO days?
Klopt het dat voor deze dagen geen maximaal geluidsniveau geldt (piekgeluid) en dat alleen tijdens UBO-dagen een strafcorrectie wordt toegepast?

v.summary: The Raad van State advises on a government bill amending the Wet geluidhinder to clarify the 12-day rule for international racing circuits, noting the explanatory memorandum misstates that the Handreiking applies to zoned industrial sites and that the bill in practice broadens the existing noise framework. The minister's reply (nader rapport) accepts that the Handreiking is not the governing framework but maintains the same representative-operating-situation logic applies, and acknowledges the bill is a relaxation rather than a mere clarification.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum wrongly states that the Handreiking Industrielawaai applies to circuits located on zoned industrial sites, and should be corrected in heading, preamble and explanation.
The bill is presented as a clarification but in substance broadens the normative noise framework for the two circuits, which the Raad considers should be acknowledged.

32360-IXB.s: This is the 2009 final budget adjustment bill (slotwet) for the Ministry of Finance, which amends the departmental budget statement and the statements for two business-operations services (Domeinen Roerende Zaken and Domeinen Onroerende Zaken/RVOB-DV) to match realised spending and revenue. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and provides for retroactive entry into force to 31 December of the budget year.
q: We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) for the year 2009
Wij ... hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën (IXB) voor het jaar 2009

32395-III.s: This bill amends the 2010 budget statements of the Ministry of General Affairs and the Cabinet of the Queen by adjusting spending and commitment figures in thousands of euros. It sets the effective date as 1 June 2010 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad is published later.
q: Thus it is that We, in joint consultation with the States General, have resolved and decided as follows: Article 1 The budget statements of the Ministry of General Affairs and the Cabinet of the Queen for 2010 are amended as shown in the statements attached to this law.

Zo is het, dat Wij, met gemeen overleg der Staten-Generaal, hebben goedgevonden en verstaan, gelijk Wij goedvinden en verstaan bij deze: Artikel 1 De begrotingsstaten van het Ministerie van Algemene Zaken en van het Kabinet der Koningin (III) voor het jaar 2010 worden gewijzigd

33090-IXA.s: This bill amends the 2011 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Nationale Schuld (National Debt, IXA) via a supplementary budget, changing expenditure and receipts amounts for debt financing and cash management. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and provides for entry into force on 1 December of the budget year with retroactive effect where publication occurs later.
q: The 2011 budget statement of the National Debt (IXA) is amended as shown in the statement attached to this act.
De begrotingsstaat van Nationale Schuld (IXA) voor het jaar 2011 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

33480-IV.s: This bill amends the 2012 budget statement for Kingdom Relations (Begrotingsstaat van Koninkrijksrelaties IV), adjusting expenditure and commitments under the policy articles on guarantee function and autonomy of Kingdom partners, following the Najaarsnota. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from 1 December 2012, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: Article 1: The budget statement of Kingdom Relations for the year 2012 is amended as shown in the statement attached to this law.
Artikel 1 De begrotingsstaat van Koninkrijksrelaties voor het jaar 2012 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

33480-VI.s: This bill amends the 2012 departmental budget statements of the Ministry of Security and Justice, adjusting obligations, expenditure and receipts across policy and non-policy articles following the Autumn Memorandum. It is a budgetary adjustment law with no new delegation or power shifts.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Security and Justice for 2012 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie, voor het jaar 2012 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

33640-IX.s: This bill amends the 2013 departmental budget statements of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the National Debt (IXA) through the first supplementary budget, adjusting appropriations and receipts in thousands of euros effective 1 June 2013. The explanatory memorandum lists the main expenditure changes, including tax collection intensification, IT and data storage, and adjustments to financial supervision contributions.
33640-IX.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to the Voorjaarsnota, the coalition agreement and cost movements in the Belastingdienst, DNB and AFM, without invoking delegated powers.
q: The budget statement of the National Debt (IXA) for the year 2013 attached to this law is amended, as shown in the corresponding statement attached to this law.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingstaat van Nationale Schuld (IXA) voor het jaar 2013 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

33699.s: The bill amends the Aliens Act 2000 to implement the EU Dublin III Regulation for determining which Member State is responsible for an asylum application. It adds new grounds for detention, transfer decisions, a four-week voluntary departure period, and direct appeal to the courts against transfer decisions.
33699.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers as necessary to implement the EU Dublin Regulation and prevent asylum seekers from making multiple applications across Member States.
q: The proposal also provides for direct appeal against an ex officio transfer decision.
Het voorstel voorziet tevens in rechtstreeks beroep bij een ambtshalve overdrachtsbesluit.
d: detailed rules on applying the power to continue border detention for Dublin transfers
minister may detain Dublin claimants with a view to transfer
minister may shorten or waive the departure period to secure transfer
p: A rejected application or a notice of transfer automatically creates unlawful-stay status and entitlement to enter homes without consent to carry out transfer, with the minister able to shorten departure periods.
The minister may detain and transfer Dublin claimants, including those with lawful residence, subject to the regulation's criteria and the existing detention review regime.
Appeals against transfer decisions are made non-suspensive, and a new rejection ground applies to those already protected elsewhere, although appeal rights are retained.

parties: Asks what sanctions apply if a transfer is blocked, how detention of Dublin claimants is justified, and what happens if a person fails to appear or leave after a rejection.
What are the consequences for a Member State to which a foreigner may not be transferred because those limits have been exceeded?
Zij vragen wat de gevolgen zijn voor een lidstaat waaraan, wegens overschrijding van die grenzen, een vreemdeling niet mag worden overgedragen.

Welcomes the EU safeguards but asks how detention is restricted as a last resort, how minors' interests and the Court of Justice ruling are protected, and how systemic deficiencies in receiving states are assessed.

With the criterion that detention is only permitted where there is a significant risk of absconding, these members assume detention is meant as an exception and last resort and should be further restricted.

Met het criterium dat bewaring enkel toegestaan is als er een significant risico op onderduiken bestaat, gaan deze leden er vanuit dat bedoeld is de bewaring hier als uitzondering en als ultimum remedium in te zetten en verder te beperken.
Questions why several grounds are needed before detention rather than one serious ground, and how the risk of absconding is controlled once detention ends.
These members ask why multiple grounds must exist before detention can occur, rather than detention already following from one of the so-called serious grounds.

Voornoemde leden vragen waarom er sprake moet zijn van meerdere gronden voordat tot bewaring kan worden overgegaan en dat niet reeds wanneer er sprake is van één van de zogenaamde zware gronden wordt overgegaan tot inbewaringstelling.

Questions whether alternatives to detention are examined as the Regulation requires, whether maximum detention periods are set in law, whether minors' consent is needed before tracing family, and whether suspension of transfers applies in systemic-failure cases.
Does an individual assessment mean that alternatives are expressly examined before foreigner detention is considered?
Betekent een individuele beoordeling dat er uitdrukkelijk wordt gekeken naar alternatieven voordat vreemdelingendetentie wordt overwogen?
Asks whether transfers happen after six weeks once detention is lifted, how the systemic-deficiency safeguard works, and how reunification of split refugee families will be handled.
These members ask whether the foreigner will actually be transferred after those six weeks, or whether a discretionary 'may' provision was deliberately chosen.
Deze leden vragen of de vreemdeling na die zes weken alsnog daadwerkelijk wordt overgedragen of is hier bewust gekozen voor een «kan»-bepaling?

Welcomes stricter detention criteria and the protection of children, but asks how absconding risk is established when asylum seekers lack documents and whether children will be detained, including at the border.
According to these members this is a positive development because strict criteria for immigration detention are set.
Volgens deze leden is dit een positieve ontwikkeling omdat er strenge criteria voor vreemdelingenbewaring gesteld worden.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the bill implementing the Dublin III regulation but raises objections on the new refusal ground for persons already granted protection elsewhere, direct appeal against transfer decisions, judicial review of detention for transfer, and the amended residence ground for non-Dublin claimants, and asks to await the final regulation text. The government reply accepts most points, adds the appeal annex, judicial review of detention and clarifies the formal application timing, while defending the new refusal ground and noting the final regulation text was adopted on 26 June 2013 without requiring re-advice.
concerns: The Afdeling questions whether the new refusal ground in article 30(1)(d) Vw 2000 is necessary, since Dublin responsibility may already cover persons holding a valid residence permit elsewhere; the government defends the ground but clarifies the explanatory memorandum.
Direct appeal against a transfer decision was not included in the annex to the General Administrative Law Act; the bill was amended to open direct appeal against ex officio transfer decisions.

Judicial review of the lawfulness of detention for transfer must be guaranteed under article 5(1)(f) ECHR and article 6 of the EU Charter; article 94(1) Vw 2000 was extended to cover articles 6a and 59a.
Higher appeal and damages provisions should expressly apply to detention for transfer; the explanatory memorandum was supplemented and related articles redrafted.

The Afdeling advised reconsidering the repeal of article 8(m) Vw 2000 for persons seeking asylum only in the Netherlands; the government maintains the timing change applies to all procedures and the ground can be dropped.
The Afdeling advised re-submitting the bill if the final regulation text required substantial changes; the government notes the final text adopted on 26 June 2013 gives no reason for re-advice.

33750-IV.s: This bill establishes the 2014 budget statement for the Kingdom Relations (IV) ministry, setting appropriations and receipts in thousands of euros. The explanatory memorandum describes funding for the Kingdom's guarantee function, financial supervision of Curaçao and Sint Maarten, and planned evaluations of constitutional arrangements.
33750-IV.j: The memorandum justifies the guarantee function and Kingdom intervention powers as strengthening local institutions in realising democratic rule of law, but this is not a delegation justification.
q: The Kingdom government may take measures if there is a serious breach of fundamental rights and freedoms in a country or a situation in which legal certainty or good governance is no longer guaranteed.

De Koninkrijksregering kan maatregelen nemen, als er sprake is van ernstige inbreuk op fundamentele rechten en vrijheden in een land of in een situatie waarin rechtszekerheid of deugdelijk bestuur niet langer gewaarborgd zijn.

33750-VI.s: This bill sets the 2014 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) for the Ministry of Security and Justice and the 2014 budgets of its agencies such as DJI, IND, CJIB, NFI and GDI. The explanatory memorandum notes that the judiciary now manages its own operations through the Raad voor de rechtspraak, while the minister keeps a supervisory responsibility.
p: The minister is not responsible for the efficiency of the judiciary's operations but keeps a supervisory responsibility over the Raad voor de rechtspraak under the Wet op de rechterlijke organisatie.

33789.s: The bill merges the municipalities of Bernisse and Spijkenisse into a new municipality named Nissewaard, abolishing the two former municipalities from the date of reorganisation. It sets transitional rules on council elections, court districts, safety regions and electoral districts, and enters into force the day after publication.
33789.j: The memorandum justifies immediate entry into force because postponement would cause excessive disadvantages for the municipalities wanting reorganisation by 1 January 2015.
q: This deviation is permissible, since postponement – given the municipalities' wish for reorganisation as of 1 January 2015 – would lead to excessive disadvantages for the municipalities.
Deze afwijking is geoorloofd, nu uitstel – gelet op de wens van de gemeenten tot herindeling per 1 januari 2015 – zou leiden tot buitensporige nadelen voor de gemeenten.

parties: The VVD raises no concerns and asks no questions about the voluntary merger.
The bill gives the members of the VVD fractie no reason to make remarks or ask questions.
Het wetsvoorstel geeft de leden van de VVD-fractie geen aanleiding tot het maken van opmerkingen en het stellen van vragen.
The PvdA welcomes the merger and hopes for swift decision-making, while asking about a possible border correction for Oudenhoorn.
These members hope for a swift conclusion of the decision-making on this reorganisation so the parties involved can continue preparations.
Deze leden hopen op een spoedige afronding van de besluitvorming rond deze herindeling, zodat de betrokken partijen de voorbereidingen kunnen vervolgen.
The PVV asks why no referendum or representative poll was held and holds that merger should proceed only if residents majority want it.
These members are of the view that reorganisation should only proceed if it is what the residents of the municipalities concerned want by majority.
Deze leden zijn van mening dat er pas tot herindeling moet worden overgegaan als dit is wat de inwoners van de betreffende gemeenten in meerderheid willen.

The SP regrets that no representative research into public support was done and asks the government to justify this, and questions the claimed gains in administrative capacity and the financial projections.
Does the government share the view of these members that representative research is necessary to obtain a clear picture of public support?
Deelt de regering de mening van deze leden dat representatief onderzoek noodzakelijk is om een eenduidig beeld te krijgen van het draagvlak?

The CDA endorses the principle that municipalities are primarily responsible for strengthening their own capacity and asks how the merger relates to a wider island-wide merger and whether administrative pressure is reduced.
To what extent is the proposed merger a step towards an island-wide merger, the members of the CDA fractie ask.
In hoeverre is de voorgestelde samenvoeging een stap in de richting van een eilandbrede fusie, zo vragen de leden van de CDA-fractie.

The SGP considers public support important, asks about the precise council vote margins, how criticisms on accessibility of officials and local taxes will be addressed, and whether a border correction for Oudenbosch should be combined with the merger.

33798.s: The bill amends the Dutch Housing Act to strengthen enforcement, creating a mandatory building-condition inspection duty for categories set by ministerial regulation, and a new power to compel property management handover (beheer) to the authority or a housing body after repeated violations, plus administrative fines. It also drops an earlier rental ban and adds an evaluation report within five years.
33798.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by the need to improve enforceability of the Housing Act against landlords who repeatedly violate it and by the deterrent effect of fines and management takeover.
q: repeated violation of article 1a or 1b, in the view of the competent authority, is accompanied by a threat to liveability or a danger to health or safety
herhaaldelijke overtreding van artikel 1a of artikel 1b naar het oordeel van het bevoegd gezag gepaard gaat met een bedreiging van de leefbaarheid of een gevaar voor de gezondheid of de veiligheid
d: categories of buildings subject to mandatory condition inspection and inspection rules
detailed rules on the height of administrative fines
p: Municipalities may compel owners to hand over management of property to the authority or a third party, with cost recovery and set-off of rents, after repeated violations threatening health, safety or liveability.
Authorities may impose administrative fines up to the third or fourth penalty category for repeated violations without a prior restorative sanction.</description_en>
Authorities may close a building for repeated violations threatening health or safety, with costs recoverable by writ of execution.</description_en>

parties: Asks the government to define 'leefbaarheid' clearly, prevent local overreach, and clarify whether building takeover decisions are open to appeal before administrative or civil courts.
Can the government indicate how it will prevent this from happening?
Kan de regering aangeven op welke wijze zij gaat voorkomen dat dit zal plaatsvinden?
Finds the bill does not go far enough, regrets that only an administrative fine remains, and wants tenants to get easier redress and residents more ability to force municipalities to enforce.
These members find this a missed opportunity and believe a rental ban or sale obligation would be justified if the owner commits such reprehensible practices.

Deze leden vinden dit een gemiste kans en zijn van mening dat een verhuurverbod of een verkoopplicht wel gerechtvaardigd zijn, indien de eigenaar zich schuldig maakt aan dergelijke verwerpelijke praktijken.
Supports the bill but asks about effectiveness, whether liability for damage can be offset against compensation in expropriation, and whether delegation to regional enforcement services is possible.
Can the implementation of this task be delegated to the Regional Enforcement Services (RUD)?
Kan de uitvoering van deze taak worden gedelegeerd aan de Regionale UitvoeringsDiensten (RUD)?
Insists the introduction of new powers, especially building takeover, needs a robust justification showing existing instruments are inadequate, and asks about municipal costs and financial risks.
Because of the weight of the intervention, a substantial justification is lacking.
Vanwege het gewicht van de ingreep wordt een dragende motivatie gemist.
Asks whether the judge must review proportionality of takeover in advance, what remedies owners have, criteria for enforcement and seizure without prior court approval, and safeguards for tenants.
Must the reasonableness and proportionality of a building takeover be reviewed in advance by the judge?
Moet de redelijkheid en proportionaliteit van een beheerovername vooraf door de rechter getoetst worden?
Supports the enforcement tools but asks whether intermediate measures such as conditional rental rights were considered and questions the feasibility and proportionality of the administrative fine.
These members ask whether it would be legally possible to attach conditions to rental, so owners keep the right to rent but only under (temporary) conditions.
Zo vragen deze leden of het wettelijk mogelijk zou zijn om voorwaarden te verbinden aan verhuur waarbij eigenaren zelf het recht op verhuur houden maar alleen onder (tijdelijke) voorwaarden.

Questions the breadth of the bill covering all owners including owner-occupiers, asks whether exceptions are possible, and asks whether the duty of care is too untargeted in its timing and conditions.
Given the requirements of due care and proportionality, is it not desirable to exclude owner-occupiers from the proposed regulation?
Is het gelet op de eisen van zorgvuldigheid en proportionaliteit niet gewenste om eigenaar-bewoners uit te zonderen van de voorgestelde regeling.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on a draft amendment to the Housing Act introducing a rental ban, changes to building management takeover, and an administrative fine, questioning necessity and effectiveness and urging reconsideration. The minister's reply removed the rental ban, adopted most changes to management takeover, and justified the administrative fine while partly adding explanation.
concerns: The rental ban was questioned on necessity, effectiveness and proportionality under Article 1 of the First Protocol ECHR, and the government dropped it.
The Council doubted the necessity and effectiveness of the building management takeover, and the government added justification and financial-risk explanation without fully establishing necessity.
The management period ended too early, deterring other managers, so the government adjusted the end condition to cover cost recovery.
The text and explanatory memorandum on conditions for imposing management takeover were inconsistent and were brought into line.
The Council asked why criminal enforcement under the Economic Offences Act was insufficient for the administrative fine, and the government supplemented the explanation while keeping the fine.

33930-IV.s: This bill amends the departmental budget statement of Kingdom Relations (IV) for 2013, adjusting appropriations and realisations by article through a supplementary and closing budget law. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the law effective retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The departmental budget statement of Kingdom Relations (IV) for the year 2013 is amended, as shown in the statement belonging to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) voor het jaar 2013 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

33930-VI.s: This bill amends the 2013 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Security and Justice and the budget statement for its operational service agencies, adjusting appropriations and realised figures by article. It also sets the amounts in thousands of euros and provides for entry into force the day after publication, with retroactive effect to 31 December of the budget year.
33930-VI.j: The memorandum explains budget variances, such as higher staffing costs at the Public Prosecution Service and unrented vacant premises, rather than justifying any delegation or new powers.
q: In addition, a savings shortfall on operating expenditure arose from vacant premises that, contrary to earlier expectations, were not sublet and were also not taken back by the RGD after the contract was dissolved.

Daarnaast is op de apparaatsuitgaven een besparingsverlies opgetreden door leegstaand van panden die in tegenstelling tot eerder voorzien, niet onderverhuurd zijn en ook niet door de RGD zijn teruggenomen door ontbinding van het contract.

33969.s: The bill amends the Strategic Services Act to implement the 2013 Arms Trade Treaty, requiring that export licences be refused where international obligations demand it and allowing the integrity assessment bureau to advise before a licence is refused or withdrawn. It also sets the entry into force by royal decree.
33969.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by the need to implement the Arms Trade Treaty's export control obligations and the existing EU common position.
q: Essentially, the Treaty obliges the treaty parties to set up an arms export system.
Essentieel is dat het Verdrag de verdragspartijen verplicht een wapenexportsysteem op te tuigen.
d: entry into force date set by royal decree
p: Licences may be refused or withdrawn on integrity grounds under the integrity assessment act, after the integrity bureau may be asked for an advice.

parties: The VVD asks whether any arms export licences that are currently possible would be excluded after the amendment, and why the Council of State's advice to make the refusal ground imperative was not adopted, including its consequences.
The members of the VVD faction have two further clarifying questions.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben nog twee verduidelijkende vragen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supported a bill amending the Wet strategische diensten to implement the Arms Trade Treaty, but objected to the open-ended 'international obligations' refusal ground and the unexplained ten-year record-keeping period, and advised revision. The government replied that it kept the broad refusal ground for future obligations, made the refusal mandatory in line with the advice, clarified the treaty criteria in the explanatory memorandum, and addressed the retention period through the archive selection list.
concerns: The open and vague term 'internationale verplichtingen' should be replaced by the specific criteria of the treaty or a reference to them, with a basis for a general administrative order; the government kept the broad formulation but clarified the criteria in the explanatory memorandum.
The refusal ground in the proposed articles should be formulated imperatively rather than facultatively, since the treaty leaves no room for weighing; the government adopted this.
The ten-year retention period for export licence records was not anchored in law; the explanatory memorandum was supplemented and the archive selection list is to be amended.
Redactional suggestions in the annex, including a reference correction in the proposed article 14(4), were adopted.

33978.s: The bill lowers the statutory pay cap for top officials in the public and semi-public sector from 130% to 100% of a minister's salary, and adjusts related rules on interim officials, internal supervisory board members (raising their caps to 10% and 15%), and transitional arrangements. It also creates a delegation allowing a general administrative order to exclude certain incidental income components from the pay definition.
33978.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation on the need for flexibility for incidental pay items and the revised time commitment of supervisory board members, and the ministerial regulation powers on the short timeline before entry into force.
q: This power to exclude components from the pay definition by general administrative order must be used sparingly.
Van deze bevoegdheid om bij algemene maatregel van bestuur onderdelen zonder meer uit te zonderen van het bezoldigingsbegrip, dient terughoudend gebruik te worden gemaakt.
d: excluding incidental income components from the pay definition
maximum pay for interim top officials serving up to twelve months
setting 2015 pay amounts by ministerial regulation, with fallback to 2014 amounts
sectoral lower maxima and differentiated norms under existing regulations
p: Lets the executive by general administrative order exclude incidental income from the pay cap, with the memorandum stating it should be used sparingly.
Raises the pay caps for internal supervisory board members from 5% and 7.5% to 10% and 15% of the maximum, increasing their pay.</description_en

parties: Asks why the 1 January 2015 start date is justified given the lack of empirical research on WNT effects, and about administrative burden and regulatory uncertainty.
They ask the government to further justify this entry-into-force date.
Zij vragen de regering deze inwerkingtredingsdatum nader te motiveren.
Supports the lower ceiling but urges great restraint on exemptions and asks how individual exceptions and incidental pay components are controlled to avoid circumvention.
The PvdA members, however, advocate great restraint in this regard, especially given the many requests from a wide range of sectors.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie pleiten in dit kader echter – zeker gezien de vele verzoeken hiertoe uit een breed scala aan sectoren – voor grote terughoudendheid.
Argues the ceiling should be below a Minister's salary, questions exemptions for incidental pay and medical specialists, and questions the very long transitional period to 2022.
It does, however, raise the question of whether a maximum below the Minister's salary should be chosen.
Het roept echter wel de vraag op of er niet moet worden gekozen voor een maximum onder het ministerssalaris.
Questions the legislative process quality, the lack of empirical evidence for the proposed norm, enforceability, and the transitional rules and their effect on labour mobility.
The CDA members consider such a justification insufficient for a far-reaching bill.
De leden van de CDA-fractie achten een dergelijke onderbouwing voor een ingrijpend wetsvoorstel onvoldoende.
Requests concrete figures on financial effects, number of affected officials, the scope of exemptions and criteria for them, and the basis for the 100% level.
The aforementioned members would like concrete figures on the financial effects of the bill.
De voornoemde leden ontvangen graag concrete cijfers over de financiële effecten van het wetsvoorstel.
Supports the principle but asks how substantial exemptions via AMvB are safeguarded against stacking and whether a prior-consultation procedure was considered.
The ChristenUnie members ask how it is guaranteed that no substantial components qualify, or that no stacking of options creates a substantial component.

Zij vragen hoe gewaarborgd wordt dat hier geen substantiële bestanddelen voor in aanmerking komen of dat er een stapeling van mogelijkheden wordt geboden die opgeteld een substantieel bestanddeel zullen vormen.
Accepts the principle but asks on what basis the Minister's salary is deemed socially acceptable, the risk of repeated pressure and legal uncertainty, and the effect on attractiveness of posts.
Especially since this bill comes so soon after the previous amendment, they wonder whether there is not a risk of repeated pressure to lower salaries further.
Zeker omdat dit wetsvoorstel zo snel na de vorige wijziging komt, vragen zij zich af of het risico niet aanwezig is dat er steeds weer druk is om het salaris verder te verlagen.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised that the proposed 25% cut in the WNT pay cap (130% to 100% of a minister's salary) be reconsidered, citing lack of justification, labour-market and property-right concerns, and insufficient transitional safeguards. The government's reply argues the cut is justified as a logical next step, promises monitoring and evaluation, adds clarifications on transitional law, DNB's position and other points, but does not provide the empirical analysis the Council requested.
concerns: The Council found no adequate justification or empirical analysis for the sharp reduction of a recently enacted norm; the government added justifications and monitoring commitments but no new research.

The cut may infringe the right to peaceful enjoyment of property under Article 1 of the First Protocol ECHR and ILO contractual freedom; the government argues it is proportionate, adding some supporting text.

The Council questioned whether the transitional regime leaves a fair balance for officials already in a phased adjustment path; the government clarified the timeline and reasoning but did not change the bill.
The Council noted uncertain effects on the wider pay structure and the need for prior analysis; the government added monitoring and evaluation passages to the explanatory memorandum.
The ECB warned that the rules could affect DNB's independence; the government stated DNB board members' pay will not be reduced during current terms and the bill applies to future cases.

33996.s: The bill amends the Dutch Betting and Gaming Act to create a licensing regime for online games of chance (kansspelen op afstand), including licence conditions, anti-addiction measures and a central exclusion register. It also extends enforcement powers of the Gaming Authority (entry, search, seizure, binding instructions to intermediaries) and adjusts the gaming tax accordingly.
33996.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and new enforcement powers as necessary to channel demand for online gambling to a regulated, supervised market and to combat illegal offerings.
q: The purpose of the bill is to channel the actual demand for online games of chance that exists now or may arise in the future.
Doel van het wetsvoorstel is de daadwerkelijke vraag naar kansspelen op afstand die nu bestaat of in de toekomst kan ontstaan, te kanaliseren.
d: grounds for refusing or withdrawing licences and licence conditions
registration and analysis of player behaviour, data processing rules
games allowed online, licence duration, transfer of licence
operational requirements, certification and consumer protection for online operators
record keeping and information provision duties for licence holders
electronic access by inspectors to gaming systems and data
binding instructions to payment and telecom providers to block gambling
financial security required from licence holders
amount of gaming levy for treatment and research of addiction
p: The gaming board may exclude a person from gambling for six months on a reasonable suspicion of harmful gambling, without a court order.
Inspectors may gain access to premises, seal property, enter homes without the occupant's consent after a prior judicial authorisation, and seize goods, with enforcement by force.
Gaming authority may exercise Dutch investigative powers on behalf of foreign regulators under cooperation agreements.
Gaming board can order payment and telecom providers to block or make inaccessible data and payments, subject to prior judicial authorisation for some orders.

parties: Asks whether lower-level regulations will be submitted to parliament via the voorhang procedure and how their scope will be kept manageable.
These members ask whether this lower-level regulation will still be submitted to the House through the so-called pre-consultation procedure.
Deze leden vragen of deze lagere regelgeving nog zal worden voorgelegd aan de Kamer door middel van de zogenoemde voorhangprocedure.
Insists on seeing the content of lower-level regulations before approving the bill and argues the bill should not enter into force without them.
They are also of the view that without that lower-level regulation being known, the present bill should not be allowed to enter into force.
Zij zijn ook van mening dat zonder dat die lagere regelgeving bekend is, het voorliggende wetsvoorstel niet in werking zou mogen treden.
Worries that excluded problem gamblers will turn to the illegal circuit and that licensees will not reliably protect players against addiction.
How does the government intend to prevent addicted players entered in this register from turning to the illegal circuit during the period they are denied access?
Hoe wil de regering voorkomen dat verslaafde spelers die in dit register worden opgenomen zich alsnog zullen wenden tot het illegale circuit
Questions the priority and evidence base of the bill, the rise in gambling addiction in Denmark, and whether the regulator's oversight and effects are adequately monitored.
These members ask whether the present bill does not show that the government holds a different view than the Senate did at the time.
Deze leden vragen of onderhavig wetsvoorstel er niet van getuigt dat de regering een andere mening is toegedaan dan de Eerste Kamer destijds.
Lacks confidence that the bill solves the problems, asks for independent research and warns that liberalisation may repeat earlier failures of market supervision.
Doubts that legalising online gambling will help prevention and questions how the government can deny that it increases demand.
They are certainly not convinced that making online gambling legally possible will contribute to this.
Zij zijn er bepaald niet van overtuigd dat het wettelijk mogelijk maken van kansspelen op afstand hieraan zal bijdragen.
Wants an effective, non-passive regulator enforcing the system fairly and a well-developed addiction approach.
The supervisor must not be toothless, but must enforce the system effectively and fairly.
De toezichthouder mag geen lam zijn, maar moet effectief en rechtvaardig het systeem handhaven.
Asks whether Denmark's liberalisation is comparable and whether charity revenues can be safeguarded, and proposes a monitoring committee of experts.
What is the government's position on establishing a 'monitoring committee for gambling modernisation' made up of experts on addiction, fair competition oversight and stakeholders?

Hoe staat de regering tegenover het instellen van een «monitoringscommissie modernisering kansspelen», bestaande uit experts op het terrein van verslaving, toezicht op eerlijke mededinging en belanghebbenden?
Fears online gambling will grow due to advertising and low entry barriers; argues for stricter rules and limiting the number of licences.
These members believe the entry thresholds in the bill for joining the Dutch market are too low to prevent a large influx of licence holders.
Deze leden zijn van mening dat de drempels in het wetsvoorstel om toe te treden tot de Nederlandse markt te laag zijn om daarmee een grote toevloed van vergunninghouders te kunnen voorkomen.
Doubts that self-exclusion and personal responsibility sufficiently protect problem gamblers and that illegal supply can be effectively policed.
These members ask whether the government is not placing too much self-discipline on an addict and whether six months is enough for adequate treatment.
Voornoemde leden vragen de regering of zij daarbij niet teveel zelfdiscipline toedicht aan een verslaafde en of zes maanden wel voldoende is om adequaat te zijn behandeld.
Alleges insufficient enforcement against unlicensed operators such as Unibet, questions the Ksa's discretion, and objects to gambling advertising and bonuses.
These members remind the government of its responsibility for the current licensing system and the Chamber's supervisory task in that regard.
Deze leden wijzen de regering op haar verantwoordelijkheid ten aanzien van het huidige vergunningstelsel en de controlerende taak die de Kamer in dat opzicht heeft.
Asks for scenarios on how regulation affects charity lottery revenues and the minimum payout percentage.
These members would therefore like to see some realistic scenarios from the government showing how regulating online gambling could affect the charity lotteries.
Deze leden zouden daarom graag enkele door de regering realistisch geachte scenario’s willen zien waarin terugkomt hoe de regulering van online kansspelen de goede doelen loterijen kan beïnvloeden.
Asks whether reducing gambling addiction is the main aim and what alternatives were considered, and questions enforcement budgets.
Can the government confirm or deny that this is the case?
Kan de regering bevestigen of ontkennen dat dit het geval is?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the draft Wet op de kansspelen amendment to regulate online gambling, doubting the effectiveness, enforceability and EU-law coherence of the proposal and advising reconsideration. The government's nader rapport replies point by point, defending the regulation, the enhanced duty of care, the expanded enforcement powers and the privacy measures while largely maintaining the bill.
concerns: The Afdeling doubts that the proposed measures will achieve the 80% channelling of online gambling and that enforcement against foreign operators is effective; the government disagrees but adds clarifications.

The Afdeling finds the enhanced duty of care for operators and the involuntary exclusion register insufficiently motivated against less intrusive alternatives; the government supplements the explanation.
The Afdeling questions whether the regime is consistent and coherent with other gambling segments as required by EU case law, including the online lottery ban and land-based casino monopolies.

The Afdeling considers the power to enter and search homes insufficiently justified under the right to privacy and home protection and advises dropping it unless necessity is shown; the government supplements its motivation.
The Afdeling notes the expansion of the Kansspelautoriteit's powers and asks for per-power justification of necessity and proportionality, which the government addresses.

The Afdeling finds the processing of sensitive personal data, including BSN and ID copies, insufficiently justified and lacking adequate safeguards under the Wbp; the government adds reasoning but keeps the data requirements.

34000-XII.s: The document is the 2015 budget bill (voorstel van wet) for the Ministry of Infrastructure and the Environment, setting departmental and agency budget statements in thousands of euros. It contains no delegation of rule-making power and only budget appropriations and expenditure tables.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and the Environment for the year 2015 attached to this law is established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu voor het jaar 2015 wordt vastgesteld.

34200-VII.s: This supplementary budget bill amends the 2014 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and the budget statement of its agency, the Basisadministratie Persoonsgegevens en Reisdocumenten. It adjusts appropriations, revenues and expenditures by article and sets the bill to take effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat

34599.s: This bill amends the departmental budget statements of the Ministry of Finance and of the National Debt contained in the 2015 Jaarverslag en Slotwet bill, adjusting appropriations and revenue figures for the realised budget. It contains no delegation of rule-making power, no new executive powers, and no explanatory memorandum beyond the statement that none was found.
q: If the bill Jaarverslag en Slotwet Ministerie van Financiën en Nationale Schuld 2015, submitted on 18 May 2016, becomes law, that law is amended as follows

ARTIKEL I Indien het op 18 mei 2016 ingediende voorstel van wet Jaarverslag en Slotwet Ministerie van Financiën en Nationale Schuld 2015 (Kamerstukken 34 475-IX ) tot wet wordt verheven, wordt die wet als volgt gewijzigd:

34779.s: The bill amends the Dutch Cable Car Installations Act to align it with EU Regulation 2016/424, replacing the old directive-based provisions with references to the regulation. It narrows the ministerial delegation for conformity assessment bodies, makes safety enforcement applicable to all cable car installations, and replaces the old enforcement provisions with direct ministerial powers over subsystems and safety components.
34779.j: The memorandum justifies the enforcement extension as needed so the Minister can act against unsafe cable cars regardless of permit status, and the fee and designation powers as aligned with EU regulation and government policy.
d: fees for designation and supervision of conformity assessment bodies
p: The Minister may now restrict, suspend or withdraw designation of conformity assessment bodies when they fail EU requirements, widening ministerial discretion over these bodies.

The Minister must take specified measures such as bans, restrictions or recalls on subsystems or safety components suspected of endangering safety, with no explicit judicial review or parliamentary involvement stated.
Administrative enforcement by order under coercion or penalty payment is extended to general safety obligations for all cable car installations, including those without permits.

parties: Asks whether the regulation's requirements are enforceable in the Dutch situation, whether conformity bodies' expanded powers were necessary, and whether the law will be evaluated after entry into force.
Was this, in the government's view, necessary as far as the Dutch situation is concerned?
Was dit naar indruk van de regering nodig voor wat betreft de Nederlandse situatie?
Asks for an overview of existing and planned cable car projects that would fall under the bill and its consequences, including a project in Venlo.
Can an overview be given of the existing initiatives and plans for building cable cars that will fall under the law?
Kan daarom een overzicht gegeven worden van de bestaande initiatieven en plannen om te komen tot de aanleg van kabelbanen die onder de wet komen te vallen?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised proceeding with the bill implementing EU Regulation 2016/424 on cable car installations, but raised one substantive objection about the transitional provision for installations built before 21 April 2018, which as drafted went beyond what Article 46 requires by abolishing the permit requirement for existing installations and curtailing existing transitional law. In its reply, the state secretary adopted the advice by separating existing transitional law from regulation-based transitional law in Article 35, and also accepted the editorial remarks on the transposition table and explanatory memorandum.
concerns: Article 35 of the bill wrongly applied to all installations placed in service before 21 April 2018 and abolished the permit requirement for them, which Article 46 of the regulation does not require; the government split the transitional provisions to address this.

The condition that installations must have fallen under the law as it stood before that date removed existing transitional protection for installations placed in service before the current law, which the government restored.
The transposition table should state how Articles 40(1)-(7) and 42(1) of the regulation are implemented, and the explanatory memorandum should address Article 48(2)(a) and (b) of the regulation.

34788.s: The bill tightens the Dutch corporate and dividend tax rules against abuse by cooperatives and holding cooperatives, including a new anti-abuse provision and new substance requirements. It also lets the Minister issue ministerial regulations setting the criteria for valid business reasons reflecting economic reality.
34788.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation of valid business reason criteria to ministerial regulations by the need to give detailed rules, and phases the regulations' entry into force to give taxpayers time to comply.
q: The proposed new fifth paragraph of Article 17 provides that rules will be set by ministerial regulation to determine what counts as valid business reasons reflecting economic reality.

In het voorgestelde vijfde lid (nieuw) van genoemd artikel 17 wordt geregeld dat bij ministeriële regeling regels worden gesteld voor de bepaling van hetgeen wordt verstaan onder geldige zakelijke redenen die de economische realiteit weerspiegelen.
d: ARTIKEL I, A.2 (Wet Vpb 1969 art. 17, vijfde lid)
criteria for valid business reasons reflecting economic reality
ARTIKEL II, C.12 (Wet DB 1965 art. 4, twaalfde lid)
criteria for valid business reasons reflecting economic reality for dividend withholding exemption
ARTIKEL II, C.11 (Wet DB 1965 art. 4, elfde lid)
rules for the information return to the inspector
p: ARTIKEL II, C.11 (Wet DB 1965 art. 4, elfde lid)
Taxpayers must provide a declaration to the inspector within a month, with details set by ministerial regulation, shifting evidentiary burden onto taxpayers.
ARTIKEL II, C.3 (Wet DB 1965 art. 4, derde lid, onderdeel c)
The new anti-abuse rule uses a subjective and objective test that gives the inspector room to deny the exemption where the main purpose is avoidance.

parties: Asks how to ensure real cooperatives are not caught, what happens if they are, and why the anti-abuse rules are needed alongside existing fraus legis doctrine.
to what extent can it be guaranteed that real cooperatives are not affected by the proposed measures.
in hoeverre kan worden gegarandeerd dat reële coöperaties niet worden geraakt door de voorliggende maatregelen.
Worries that structures can easily be converted to fall under the exemption and asks how the Tax Administration can enforce the exemption, which it says will be only selectively monitored.
These members fear, however, that a structure can easily be converted into one where the cooperative falls under the withholding exemption.
Deze leden vrezen echter dat een structuur makkelijk om te zetten is tot een structuur waarbij de coöperatie valt onder de inhoudingsvrijstelling.

Argues the 100,000 euro wage-cost substance criterion is too weak, that the exemption turns the Netherlands into a conduit country, and that non-holding cooperatives may leak dividends to tax havens without withholding.
The SP members are not happy with the unilateral extension of the withholding exemption, which will make the Netherlands an even larger conduit country.

Niet te spreken zijn de leden van de SP-fractie over de uitbreiding van de inhoudingsvrijstelling op eenzijdige basis, waardoor Nederland een alleen nog maar grotere rol gaat spelen als doorstroomland.
Asks how the 70 percent test and substance criteria are defined and monitored, and whether the new criteria can easily be circumvented.
The D66 members ask whether the government receives signals that the two additional new criteria can easily be circumvented.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen of de regering ten aanzien van de substancecriteria signalen ontvangt dat het tweetal aanvullende nieuwe criteria ... makkelijk kunnen worden omzeild
Asks why stricter substance criteria were not chosen than the BEPS criteria.
These members ask why stricter criteria were not chosen.
Deze leden vragen waarom niet is gekozen voor strengere criteria.
Expresses understanding for the proposed changes and asks how the bill relates to the planned abolition of dividend tax.
have understanding for the proposed changes.
hebben begrip voor de voorgestelde wijzigingen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on the draft Wet inhoudingsplicht houdstercoöperatie en uitbreiding inhoudingsvrijstelling, asking for a justification of the 1 January 2018 start date in light of the Belastingdienst's implementation test and for explanation of transitional rules and the EUR 100,000 wage-cost threshold for the substance requirement. The Secretary of State replied that the start date can be kept, the Belastingdienst will try to make forms available in time with no fines if not, and the explanatory memorandum has been supplemented on these points.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for a justification of the 1 January 2018 start date given the Belastingdienst's implementation risks, and for possibly delaying entry into force until forms are ready; the government kept the date, citing budgetary links and the corporate tax period, but supplemented the memorandum and committed to timely notice.

The Afdeling noted that the explanatory memorandum did not address how the new 24-month substance requirement applies to pre-existing situations (transitional law), and the reply does not clearly answer this.

The Afdeling questioned why the EUR 100,000 wage-cost threshold was chosen and whether a rebuttal option is needed for non-artificial cases; the government's reply states the memorandum was supplemented on these points.

34797.s: The bill amends many health, youth-care and related laws to replace references to the Staatstoezicht op de volksgezondheid, IGZ and IJZ with a single new Inspectie gezondheidszorg en jeugd (IGJ), following the merger of the two inspectorates. It mainly consolidates existing inspection powers and terminology, with no substantive change to those powers.
34797.j: The memorandum justifies the approach as a technical merger needing only minor changes to existing law, keeping the inspectorate under the ministry while preserving its statutory duties.
q: The bill further provides for transferring the existing statutory powers of the IGZ and IJZ to the IGJ.
Het wetsvoorstel strekt voorts tot overheveling van de bestaande wettelijke bevoegdheden van de IGZ en de IJZ naar de IGJ.
d: Artikel I–XLIX (general provisions on inspection powers)
designation of IGJ as supervisory body under Staatstoezicht op de volksgezondheid
p: Removes the separate statutory basis of the IJZ as an independent inspectorate and places youth-care supervision under the IGJ within the executive ministry structure, while retaining ministerial instruction duties.

parties: Asks what the fusion means for supervisory capacity, how ministerial responsibility for the new inspectorate is shared, and how integrated supervision in the social domain will work.
The CDA members ask what consequences this has for the capacity of supervision.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen welke gevolgen dit heeft voor de capaciteit van het toezicht.
Supports the fusion but asks whether efficiency includes cost aspects and how the claimed quality improvement of supervision on youth care will be realised and why it is limited to youth care.
Can the government explain how this quality improvement of supervision will take shape?
Kan de regering uitleggen hoe deze kwaliteitsverbetering van het toezicht vorm gaat krijgen?
Accepts the fusion but asks whether efficiency and effectiveness gains affect the quality and capacity of supervision, and whether the inspectorate will check privacy and waiting lists.
These members ask to what extent this has consequences for the quality of supervision.
Genoemde leden vragen in hoeverre dit gevolgen heeft voor de kwaliteit van het toezicht.

Has doubts about whether both inspectorates are ready for the fusion, objects to fragmented supervision of the Wmo by municipalities who check their own policy, and asks for independent oversight and registration of private youth care providers.
These members find the fragmentation in this supervision undesirable.
Genoemde leden vinden de versnippering in dit toezicht onwenselijk.

v.summary: The Raad van State advises sending the bill merging the Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg and Inspectie Jeugdzorg into the IGJ to the Tweede Kamer, but asks the government to address the need to re-examine and reorganise supervision in the social domain following the decentralisations, including the relationship with other inspectorates. The minister's nader rapport responds that the question should be considered further in light of experience, awaiting planned evaluations of the Wmo 2015 and Jeugdwet and the social domain programme, and that the explanatory memorandum has been supplemented.
concerns: The Afdeling objects that the bill ignores the need to re-examine and redesign supervision after the decentralisations in the social domain, and the government responds by postponing that question until evaluations are available while adding explanation to the memorandum.

The Afdeling asks that the explanatory memorandum address the relationship with other national inspectorates such as Inspectie SZW and the Onderwijsinspectie, and the government supplemented the memorandum on the IGJ's position and integrated supervision initiatives.

34869.s: This bill amends the 2018 budget of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (Koninkrijksrelaties, part IV) by an incidental supplementary budget, increasing spending authorisations and expenditure, notably for emergency aid and reconstruction on the windward islands. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and makes the change effective from 1 February 2018, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: the need has emerged to amend the budget statement of Kingdom Relations (IV), all for the year 2018
de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van Koninkrijksrelaties (IV), alle voor het jaar 2018

34887.s: The bill is a miscellaneous technical omnibus amending numerous Justice and Security laws, correcting cross-references, drafting errors, and outdated provisions across civil, criminal, administrative and other statutes. It also restores some omitted measures and adjusts jurisdiction, griffierecht, and procedural rules without substantially shifting power to the executive.
34887.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as technical corrections of omissions the legislature already intended, so the delegations are presented as non-controversial restorations.
q: Since this bill contains only technical amendments, or minor amendments restoring omissions of the legislature, it meets the criterion that omnibus legislation may not contain politically contested amendment proposals.

Nu dit wetsvoorstel enkel technische wijzigingen bevat, of wijzigingen van ondergeschikte aard die omissies van de wetgever herstellen, is voldaan aan het criterium dat een verzamelwetgeving geen (politiek) omstreden wijzigingsvoorstellen mag behelzen.
d: legal status and appointment requirements of National Rapporteur on trafficking
domains of criminal offences for special investigating officers
p: Lets a ministerial regulation define the offence domains over which special investigating officers have investigative powers, which can cover all offences.

parties: The VVD asks whether the government will bring omnibus bills more often to correct technical errors faster, and why the maximum prison term in the International Crimes Act was not updated, plus whether anyone has been convicted under that article.
The said members ask whether it is an idea to come with an omnibus bill more often, so that imperfections can be corrected more quickly.
Voornoemde leden vragen of het een idee is vaker met een verzamelwet te komen, zodat onvolkomenheden sneller kunnen worden aangepast.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division broadly supports the Verzamelwet Veiligheid en Justitie 2017 but raises concerns that the proposed bailiff-led forced viewing of a mortgaged home lacks the safeguards of art. 444 Rv, and asks about the Rotterdam court's implications for court fees in debt-relief cases. The government's nader rapport defends the omission on the grounds of the limited nature of viewing, prior notice and the right to redeem, and makes technical and redactional amendments, while only partly addressing the fee question.
concerns: Forced viewing of a dwelling without the safeguards of art. 444 Rv (bailiff accompanied by mayor or police officer) needs justification and clarification of the relation to the Awbi.
The relation between the proposed art. 550 Rv and existing art. 444 Rv and the Awbi should be clarified in the explanatory memorandum.
Whether the Rotterdam court ruling on court fees for debt-relief cases warrants amending the law should be addressed; the government instead extends the lowest fee rate to Wgs disputes.
Redactional corrections and additional articles proposed in the redactional annex are incorporated into the bill.

34896.s: The bill amends the 2018 departmental budget of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management, adding supplementary spending and revenue related to the Thermphos case, with effect from 1 March 2018. It contains no delegation of rule-making power and no changes to oversight or judicial review.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management XII for the year 2018
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat XII voor het jaar 2018

34959.s: The bill makes urgent technical repairs to the corporate tax fiscal unity regime to align it with EU law following a Court of Justice ruling, including applying certain anti-abuse rules as if no fiscal unity existed and a transitional rule for interest deduction. It also corrects a gap in the innovation box so the effective tax rate difference is removed retroactively from 1 March 2018.
34959.j: The memorandum justifies the retroactive repairs by the need to remove EU-law incompatibilities identified by the Court of Justice and to prevent large budgetary effects from taxpayers selectively invoking fiscal unity advantages.
q: With this bill, the conflicts with EU law identified by the Court of Justice regarding the present urgent repair measures are removed.
Met dit voorstel van wet worden de door het HvJ EU geconstateerde strijdigheden met het EU-recht wat betreft de onderhavige spoedreparatiemaatregelen weggenomen.

parties: Asks for detailed justification of the budget loss estimate, the retroactive date and the choice not to wait for the Supreme Court ruling, while stressing the importance of the fiscal unity for investment climate.
Doubts the necessity of adapting the regime given A-G Wattel's conclusion and worries about feasibility, especially due to retroactivity; asks why provisions beyond art. 10a are included.
These members doubt the necessity of adapting the fiscal unity after the CJEU ruling of 22 February 2018, given Advocate-General Wattel's conclusion of 8 June 2018.

De leden van de CDA-fractie twijfelen aan de noodzaak om na het arrest van het HvJ EU van 22 februari 2018 de fiscale eenheid aan te passen, gezien de conclusie van Advocaat-Generaal (A-G) Wattel d.d.
Asks how the A-G opinion weighs, whether the bill should be amended or held until the Supreme Court rules, and how it relates to the CJEU judgment.
These members ask whether, according to the government, this opinion gives reason to amend the bill or to postpone it until the Supreme Court ruling.
Deze leden vragen of deze opinie volgens de regering aanleiding vormt om het wetsvoorstel aan te passen of tot aan de uitspraak van de Hoge Raad aan te houden.
Questions the budget estimate of 352 million euro, the speed of the process and the decision to retroactively apply measures on 25 October 2017; asks for internal memos and analyses.
Can the government send the Chamber the memos/notes prepared for the urgent measures?
Kan de regering de Kamer de memo’s/notities in voorbereiding op de spoedmaatregelen sturen?
Criticises the multinationals-driven reform that burdens SMEs and asks why earlier alternatives, a group relief model and a longer analysis were not pursued; supports retroactivity in principle.
The PvdA members fully support the retroactive effect of the measure.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie steunen de terugwerkende kracht van de maatregel zonder meer.
Relays NOB and VNO-NCW criticism: retroactivity causes legal uncertainty, the bill should await the Supreme Court and the government should consider the alternatives and feasibility.
The 50PLUS members ask whether the government can respond to the introductory comments of VNO-NCW and MKB-Nederland.
De leden van de fractie van 50PLUS vragen of de regering een reactie kan geven op het volgende inleidende commentaar van VNO-NCW en MKB-Nederland.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advises sending the bill on urgent repair of the fiscal unity regime (Vpb) to the Tweede Kamer, while raising practical enforceability concerns about the interest deduction limit of art. 13l and asking for CPB certification of budget estimates to justify retroactive effect. The government's nader rapport addresses these points by adding a CPB-certified budget annex, clarifying the enforcement and interim-loan issues, and revising the bill and explanatory memorandum accordingly.
concerns: The Belastingdienst considers enforcement of art. 13l under the bill not feasible without selective supervision, and the Afdeling asks whether budget estimates account for weak enforceability; the government moves to selective supervision and states the budgetary effects are not expected to change.

Retroactive effect of a burdensome measure conflicts with legal certainty unless special circumstances justify it; the Afdeling asks for better substantiation, and the government adds CPB certification of the budget estimates and explains the retroactivity rationale.
Redactional comments on the transitional measure and technical clarifications were incorporated into the bill and explanatory memorandum.

Interest on internal loans within a fiscal unity should be taken outside the test or made fiscally visible; the government addresses this via a new art. 15(16) Wet Vpb 1969 provision rendering intragroup debt visible.

34960-III.s: The bill amends the 2018 budget statements of the Ministry of General Affairs (IIIA), the Cabinet of the King (IIIB) and the Oversight Committee on the Intelligence and Security Services (IIIC) through a first supplementary budget. It adds funds such as wage and price adjustments and transfers budget between these entities, with entry into force from 1 June 2018.
q: The budget statements that form part of the national budget are each separately established and therefore also amended by law, under Article 1(3) of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001.
De begrotingsstaten die onderdeel zijn van de Rijksbegroting, worden op grond van artikel 1, derde lid, van de Comptabiliteitswet 2001 elk afzonderlijk bij wet vastgesteld en derhalve ook gewijzigd.

34968.s: The bill amends the Wet studiefinanciering 2000 to reduce the number of public transport fines by requiring student travel products to be stopped within a set deadline after entitlement ends, with fines of EUR 75 and EUR 150 per half month for continued use. It also allows the minister to use citizen service numbers and transport data held by RSR to check whether the travel product was still used after entitlement lapsed.
34968.j: The memorandum justifies the new data powers as necessary because RSR alone can link citizen service numbers to OV-chipkaarten, which is needed to establish reliably whose card was used.
q: Since RSR is the only organisation holding the link between the citizen service number and the OV-chipkaart, and this link is needed to establish with certainty whose card was used, this expansion of powers is necessary for implementing Article 3.27(2).

Aangezien RSR als enige betrokken organisatie over de koppeling beschikt van het burgerservicenummer met de daarbij behorende OV-chipkaart, en deze koppeling nodig is om met zekerheid te kunnen vaststellen aan wie de gebruikte OV-chipkaart toebehoort, is deze bevoegdheidsuitbreiding noodzakelijk voor de uitvoering van artikel 3.27, tweede lid.
d: manner of terminating travel entitlement and proof of non-attributability
p: Introduces monthly fines on students who keep using a travel product after entitlement ends, with an exemption where non-attributability is shown.
Artikel 3.23, eerste lid, en artikel 9.6 (nieuw tweede en derde lid)
Extends the minister's use of citizen service numbers and RSR travel-usage data to check post-entitlement travel, a data-processing power over students.

parties: Asks whether the duty to deactivate the travel product applies only to higher education students or also to mbo students, and asks about the blacklist capacity and the effects of shortening the fine period.
The VVD members read that the WSF 2000 explicitly states that the student is obliged to take care of timely deactivation of the travel product themselves.
De leden van de VVD-fractie lezen dat in de WSF 2000 eenduidig wordt opgenomen dat de studerende verplicht is zelf zorg te dragen het reisproduct tijdig stop te zetten.
Asks how new technologies such as Account Based Ticketing relate to the bill and whether a new amendment would be needed if they are introduced.
If new technological developments for automatic deactivation of the travel product are implemented, would a new legislative amendment be needed, these members ask.
Als nieuwe technologische ontwikkelingen voor het automatisch stopzetten van het reisproduct geïmplementeerd worden, is er dan een nieuwe wetswijziging nodig, zo vragen deze leden.
