Objects to the rise in fines after the first month and to the deployment of bailiffs, asks for the government's justification, and asks for sanctions on mbo institutions that inform students poorly, while noting the ATR advice was not adopted.
The SP members are, however, displeased about the increase of the fine after the first month.
De leden zijn echter wel ontstemd over het verhogen van de boete na de eerste maand.

34977.s: The bill makes numerous technical amendments across social security and employment laws (AKW, Anw, AOW, Wajong, WW, ZW, WIA, Participatiewet and BES-laws), mainly replacing 'bekend gemaakt' with 'medegedeeld', adjusting percentages and amounts, and extending appeal and advisory procedures to the BES islands. It also adds a legal basis for the labour inspectorate to process health data in investigations of fatal or serious workplace accidents and broadens data sharing with private cao-supervisors.
34977.j: The memorandum justifies the health-data powers by the need for investigation of serious accidents, the Awb's cooperation duty, and GDPR Article 9 requirements for safeguards.
d: announcing changed percentages in the Staatscourant
ARTIKEL XI, D (art. 37 Wet AOV BES)
manner of notifying decisions where direct delivery fails
ARTIKEL XVI, E/F and ARTIKEL XXXI, E (art. 101 WWIK)
extension of decision period for persons abroad
ARTIKEL XV (art. 4, lid 7 Wet AVV-gedetacheerde werknemers)
rules on data processed for cross-border posted-worker supervision
p: Allows the labour inspectorate to process health data of accident victims without consent, limited to investigations and bound by a confidentiality duty.
Broadens the categories of data the inspectorate may pass to private cao-supervisors.
Repeals a provision of the Toeslagenwet, removing a procedural rule.

parties: Asks how the transfer of data to private supervisors is limited to what is necessary and what safeguards apply, and how GDPR compliance is ensured.
The VVD members ask how the transfer of data is limited to the data necessary for carrying out supervision.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen hoe de overdracht van gegevens beperkt is tot die gegevens die noodzakelijk zijn voor de uitvoering van het toezicht.
Asks whether the Wajong study rules and student-finance definitions create unequal treatment, and whether the Inspectie's data-collection measures are GDPR-compliant and workable.
The D66 members ask what special measures the Inspectie SZW takes to ensure the collection of personal data complies with the GDPR.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen welke bijzondere maatregelen de Inspectie SZW treft om de verzameling van persoonsgegevens in overeenstemming te laten zijn met de AVG.

Criticises the partial rather than full abolition of the Wajong study exclusion, questions the retroactivity clause and the failure to implement the Siderius motion, and asks whether the quality of debt mediators is safeguarded when commercial and non-limited bodies may be admitted.
Do the SP members read it correctly that this bill does not abolish the study rule in Wajong2010 and the study exclusion in Wajong2015, but only aligns the definitions of 'studying'?

Lezen de leden van de SP-fractie het goed dat in voorliggend wetsvoorstel niet de studieregeling in de Wajong2010 en de uitsluitingsgrond studerende in de Wajong2015 worden geschrapt maar dat slechts de definities van «studeren» gelijk worden getrokken?
Asks about the status of the UWV implementation test, data exchange readiness between UWV and DUO, and the SVB proposal on anti-cumulation.
The CDA members have noted the responses from the various implementing bodies consulted and have a number of questions about them.
De leden van de CDA-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van de reacties van de verschillende betrokken uitvoeringsorganisaties die om advies zijn gevraagd en hebben hierover een aantal vragen.
Welcomes the lifelong-learning credit exemption for Wajong but worries about implementation readiness, UWV's unfinished test and DUO data-exchange timing.
The GroenLinks members are pleased that for Wajong the lifelong-learning credit is excluded from the concept of student finance.
De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie zijn verheugd dat voor de Wajong het levenlanglerenkrediet wordt uitgezonderd van het begrip studiefinanciering.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised the Verzamelwet SZW 2019, a collection of technical and minor policy amendments to social affairs laws, to proceed but asked that the entry-into-force provision specify which parts have retroactive effect and from when. The minister's nader rapport reports that the provision was amended accordingly, along with some minor redactional changes and an additional amendment to the Wet overige OCW-subsidies.
concerns: Retroactive effect should be specified in the bill itself for each part concerned and up to what date, given possible burdensome effects.

34986.s: The bill supplements and amends the Omgevingswet (Environment and Planning Act), including new rules on compensation for damage and tolerance duties, enforcement and administrative fines, the Digitaal Stelsel Omgevingswet, implementation of the revised NEC directive, a catch-all prohibition on activities with significant adverse effects on the physical environment, and numerous technical and competence adjustments. It also repeals 14 laws and amends 54 others, with transitional provisions.
34986.j: The memorandum justifies the new and adjusted powers by the need to align the Omgevingswet with changed related legislation, EU directives, parliamentary motions and practical experience in implementation.
q: Changes in European rules, motions and undertakings to the House of Representatives and Senate, and evolving insight from elaborating the law in general administrative measures, have led to proposed adjustments

Wijzigingen in Europese regels, moties van en toezeggingen aan Tweede en Eerste Kamer en voortschrijdend inzicht naar aanleiding van de uitwerking van de wet in de algemene maatregelen van bestuur, hebben geleid tot voorgestelde aanpassingen
d: elaboration and limitation of ban on activities with significant adverse effects
cases where environmental rules may only be placed in omgevingsplan or regional regulations
designation of state waters and waterway boundaries
designation and geometric delimitation of other locations
distance around offshore mining installation for restriction area
exemption from environmental rules by provincial executive on request of municipality or water board
transfer of competent authority between administrative bodies
time limits for seasonal and floating construction
information obligations for nadeelcompensatie in plans and regulations
information to be made available via the national digital system
requirements for question trees and data standards in digital system
p: Introduces a general prohibition on activities with significant adverse effects on the physical environment, with details left to an amvb.
Allows public authorities to recover compensation from initiators via contract or public-law claim.
Introduces administrative fines for environmental and heritage violations, with the authority setting its own fine policy and collecting fines itself.
Allows royal decree to annul water board decisions contrary to rules or instructions.
Allows the minister to act in place of a water board that fails to follow instructions, at the board's expense.

parties: Asks how the government will support municipalities in implementing the greater discretion and responsibility the act gives them, and what beyond regulatory change is needed for the claimed paradigm shift.
It is nonetheless expected that the government will support the municipalities where necessary.
Er wordt wel verwacht dat de regering de gemeenten begeleidt waar nodig.
Wants sufficient certainty and equal protection (environment, legal positions) for citizens and courts, and warns that the balance between using flexibility and protecting must not tip toward use.
They believe citizens, government and judges must have sufficient guidance and that the balance between 'using' and 'protecting' must not tip toward using.
Zij menen dat burger, overheid en rechter voldoende houvast moeten hebben en dat de balans tussen «benutten» en «beschermen» niet mag doorslaan naar benutten.
Supports the act but asks about municipalities' capacity, financial and personnel resources, and democratic control in practice, such as in the Binckhorst project.
Does the government have insight into whether there are sufficient resources (financial and personnel) to take on the implementation?
Heeft de regering er zicht op of er voldoende middelen (financieel en personeel) zijn om de invoering ter hand te nemen?
Argues that open norms and exemptions reduce legal certainty and threaten environmental quality, and asks for an independent evaluation and clear participation rules to protect residents.
With all the possibilities for deviation, these members wonder how legal certainty is ensured.
Met alle afwijkingsmogelijkheden vragen deze leden zich af hoe het zit met de rechtszekerheid.
Concerned that splitting the reform across several laws and delegated regulations creates unclarity, and asks what happens if the act or regulations are not adopted.
They therefore ask the government to give more insight into the progress of the system reform.
Zij vragen de regering daarom dan ook meer inzicht te geven in de voortgang van de stelselherziening
Questions whether legal certainty and public health protection remain adequate given the flexibility, and whether planning damage compensation for indirect damage is fair to homeowners.
They ask whether the normal societal risk for homeowners and the benefit to a project developer from a planning intervention are still in balance.
Zij vragen in hoeverre normaal maatschappelijk risico voor woningbezitters en het voordeel van een projectontwikkelaar bij een planologische ingreep nog in balans is.

Criticises the civil-law route and the design of planning damage compensation for shadow damage, and asks the government to reconsider the provisions, questioning the 5% threshold and missing clarity on enforcement regimes.
Is the government willing to reconsider the mentioned provisions, for example through advice from a committee of wise persons?
Is de regering bereid de genoemde bepalingen te heroverwegen, bijvoorbeeld middels advisering door een commissie van wijzen?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State issued an integrated opinion on the Invoeringswet Omgevingswet and four draft implementing decrees, raising concerns about legal certainty, flexibility, equivalent protection and implementation burdens on municipalities, and recommending an independent evaluation with statutory safeguards. The minister's nader rapport responds point by point, accepting some advice (compensation scheme details, notification duty, evaluation focus, invoeringsondersteuning) while rejecting or qualifying others (kwaliteitsteam, reserving the broader discretion as a deliberate choice).
concerns: Flexibility and discretion may leave insufficient houvast for citizens, businesses, government and courts, risking legal uncertainty.
Municipalities face heavy implementation burdens and dependence on ICT (DSO), creating risks for the new system unless capacity and support are strengthened.
Equivalent protection of environment, health and legal protection is not guaranteed by the rules alone; reliance falls on decentralised decisions.
Projectbesluit exemption could wrongly suggest deviation from EU or international obligations implemented via instructieregels; a correction was made.
Explanatory notes on compensation, transitional law and the evaluation provision were clarified.

35095-III.s: This second supplementary budget bill amends the 2018 budget statements for the Ministry of General Affairs, the King's Cabinet and the Supervisory Committee on the Intelligence and Security Services, with net changes of about 1.5 million euros in expenditure and a 500,000 euro revenue shortfall. It is a purely budgetary adjustment with no delegation of rule-making power or change to institutional checks.
q: The present bill aims to make changes for the year 2018 to the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of General Affairs (IIIA), the budget statement of the King's Cabinet (IIIB) and the budget statement of the Supervisory Committee on the Intelligence and Security Services (IIIC).

Het onderhavige wetsvoorstel strekt ertoe om voor het jaar 2018 wijzigingen aan te brengen in de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Algemene Zaken (IIIA), de begrotingsstaat van het Kabinet van de Koning (IIIB) en de begrotingsstaat van de Commissie van Toezicht op de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten (IIIC).

35350-IX.s: This second supplementary budget bill amends the 2019 budget statements for the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the National Debt (IXA), changing appropriations and receipts in thousands of euros effective from 1 December 2019. The explanatory memorandum details budget changes by policy article, such as lower coin production costs and lower interest expenditure.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) for 2019 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
Artikel 1 De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën (IXB) voor het jaar 2019 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35499.s: The bill amends the 2020 departmental budget of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science, adding about 28.5 million euro for tackling teacher shortages and strengthening teacher training. It sets the budget in thousands of euro and makes the change effective from 19 June 2020.
35499.j: The memorandum justifies the budget change by the extra funds made available in the Spring Memorandum 2020 for the teacher shortage problem.
q: This supplementary budget concerns the extra funds of 28.5 million euro made available in the Spring Memorandum 2020 for tackling shortages in education and teacher training.

Deze Incidentele Suppletoire Begroting heeft betrekking op de extra middelen van € 28,5 miljoen die beschikbaar zijn gesteld bij Voorjaarsnota 2020 voor de aanpak van tekorten in het onderwijs en de lerarenopleidingen.

35589.s: The bill amends the Wet werk en inkomen naar arbeidsvermogen and the Ziektewet so that UWV, when assessing re-integration efforts during the waiting period, starts from the incapacity-for-work assessment reflected in the occupational physician's or arbodienst advice. It also requires an evaluation report to parliament within four years.
35589.j: The memorandum justifies the change by noting that disagreements between occupational and insurance physicians drive a share of wage sanctions, and that the change aims to align the assessments on common starting points.
q: In the assessment, UWV proceeds from the representation of incapacity for work due to illness that appears from the assistance provided by the persons or arbodienst referred to in article 25(5) regarding the advice on incapacity for work due to illness of the insured person.

Bij de beoordeling gaat het UWV uit van de weergave van de ongeschiktheid tot het verrichten van arbeid wegens ziekte die blijkt uit de door de in artikel 25, vijfde lid, bedoelde personen of arbodienst verleende bijstand
d: UWV assessment basis via occupational health advice
p: UWV must take the occupational physician's incapacity assessment as its starting point, removing the insurance physician's independent medical judgment and limiting the employee's ability to contest that advice in administrative appeal.
The same starting-point rule is extended to the Uitvoeringsinstituut werknemersverzekeringen under the Ziektewet.
The minister must report to the Staten-Generaal on effectiveness and effects within four years.

parties: Asks what small employers are, how their needs compare with larger employers, and the status of the other package measures; does not raise a check concern.
The package of measures of which this amendment is part responds to the needs of small employers, as stated in the explanatory memorandum.
Het pakket aan maatregelen waar deze wetswijziging deel van uitmaakt sluit aan «bij de behoeften van kleine werkgevers», zo is te lezen in de memorie van toelichting.

Supports reducing employer burdens but asks whether re-integration obligations and the UWV re-integration check remain guaranteed and how the roles of occupational and insurance physicians will be separated.
Asks the government to reflect on conflicting consultation advice and whether a joint assessment framework and a check on occupational physicians' advice can be kept.
These members ask whether this could be a simpler solution to the experienced problems, while retaining the benefit of a check on the occupational physician's advice.
Deze leden vragen of dit een eenvoudigere oplossing zou kunnen zijn voor de ervaren knelpunten, waarbij het voordeel van een controle op het advies van de bedrijfsarts blijft bestaan.
Not convinced of necessity; worries that removing the insurance physician's review weakens the separation between assessing and treating, and shifts uncertainty to employees.
They are not convinced of the necessity of this bill and have some questions about it.
Zij zijn niet overtuigd van de noodzaak van dit wetsvoorstel en hebben hierover nog enkele vragen.
Views the bill as disproportionate and asks whether it should be withdrawn; questions how employees can challenge the occupational physician's judgment.
Does the government share the SP members' view that this bill is wholly disproportionate and should therefore be withdrawn as soon as possible?
Deelt de regering de mening van de leden van de SP-fractie dat voorliggende wetsvoorstel totaal disproportioneel is en derhalve zo snel mogelijk moet worden ingetrokken.
Strongly doubts necessity; argues the bill removes the verzekeringsarts check, leaves courts as the only remedy, weakens physician independence, and harms low-income employees' access to appeal.
These members seriously question the purpose and necessity of this bill.
Deze leden vragen zich ernstig af wat nut en noodzaak van dit wetsvoorstel is.

Acknowledges employer problems but asks about the proportionality of the bill given few cases of divergent opinions, the effect of the wage sanction on re-integration, and safeguards for second opinions and physician independence.
They do, however, have some questions for the government on this.
Zij hebben daarover wel enkele vragen aan de regering.
Questions whether removing the insurance physician's assessment from the reintegration check weakens employees' legal protection and shifts risk onto employees, and whether the bill is proportionate.

Asks about the joint assessment framework (gemeenschappelijk beoordelingskader) that is central to the bill's workability, including whether it is ready and how it will be applied uniformly by occupational physicians.
This is an important condition for the feasibility of this bill.
Dit is een belangrijke voorwaarde voor de uitvoerbaarheid van dit wetsvoorstel.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill making the occupational physician's assessment of work capacity binding in UWV's re-integration report test, advising that a common assessment framework for occupational physicians be in place before introduction. The government's reply accepts the need for that framework and moves the introduction date from 1 January 2021 to 1 September 2021.
concerns: Introduction of the measure should await a common assessment framework for occupational physicians and adequate training of labour experts, so the measure is implementable.
Without a common framework the measure may fail its purpose, since labour experts could still find re-integration efforts inadequate and impose wage sanctions.
The explanatory memorandum should address the framework issue and be amended to reflect the revised introduction date.

35598.s: The bill amends the Childcare Act to tighten and clarify eligibility for childcare allowance, including excluding unpaid work not generating income under the Income Tax Act 2001, extending education eligibility to vocational and other schooling, and adding entitlement for parents of partners with long-term care (Wlz) status. It also includes a transitional rule keeping the old entitlement for one year for parents who were eligible before entry into force.
35598.j: The memorandum justifies the restored link to the Income Tax Act 2001 by pointing to the Council of State ruling and the aim of making work and care combinable, with the Tax Authority's verification role serving to prevent fraud.
q: When determining whether work giving entitlement to childcare allowance is performed, the Tax Authority will again in all cases be able to rely on the income determination made by the inspector.

De Belastingdienst/Toeslagen zal bij de bepaling of sprake is van het verrichten van arbeid dat recht geeft op kinderopvangtoeslag weer in alle gevallen kunnen uitgaan van de vaststelling van het inkomen door de inspecteur.
d: ARTIKEL I, onderdeel G (artikel 1.6, zevende lid)
calendar year in which employment ended for extended six-month entitlement
p: ARTIKEL I, onderdeel H (artikel 1.6, achtste en negende lid)
Adds entitlement categories tied to Wlz care status and CIZ determinations, which expands eligibility rather than reducing protection.

parties: Asks how the Belastingdienst will verify partner-contribution and how the group affected by the paid-work requirement is registered and checked.
Why is it not possible to fully automate this process so that all parents with a Wlz indication receive the correct childcare allowance?
Waarom is het niet mogelijk dit proces volledig te automatiseren, zodat alle ouders met een Wlz-indicatie de juiste kinderopvangtoeslag krijgen?
Supports the permanent-indication extension but asks why temporary-indication parents are excluded and questions the reclaim rules and pending municipal SMI research.
However, these members ask why the government chooses to exclude parents with a temporary Wlz indication and not grant them the right to childcare allowance.
Wel vragen deze leden waarom de regering ervoor kiest om ouders met een tijdelijke Wlz-indicatie uit te zonderen en hen geen recht te geven op kinderopvangtoeslag.

Welcomes the change but criticises the unequal treatment of temporary-indication parents, warns against families falling between stools, and worries about burdens of proactive application and data sharing with the tax authority.

Moreover, these members share the Council of State's view that there is 'no objective justification' for granting childcare allowance to families where one parent has a permanent Wlz indication but not to families where one parent has a temporary one.

Bovendien delen voornoemde leden de mening van de Raad van State dat er «geen objectieve rechtvaardiging» is om gezinnen waar één ouder een permanente Wlz-indicatie heeft wel recht te geven op kinderopvang toeslag, maar dit recht niet toe te kennen aan gezinnen waar één ouder een tijdelijke Wlz-indicatie heeft.

Welcomes the permanent-indication extension but fears people with temporary or chronic conditions, and municipalities burdened without funds, will fall outside the scheme; asks for quantified impacts and reconsideration of unemployment rules.
However, these members, like the Council of State, are concerned that this only concerns those with a permanent indication.
Deze leden maken zich net als de Raad van State echter zorgen over het feit dat het hierbij enkel gaat om diegenen die een permanente indicatie hebben.
Asks whether municipalities should decide which groups get support and why partners with long-term disability are excluded; questions the complexity of the unemployment-period rules.
These members ask the government about the scope for customisation that municipalities have to provide a contribution towards childcare costs.
Deze leden vragen de regering naar het maatwerk dat gemeenten hebben om een tegemoetkoming te geven in de kosten van de kinderopvang.
Asks for justification of the group boundaries, recognition of unpaid work, and the burden of proactive reporting and regulatory cost for parents and childcare firms.
These members believe that unpaid work should also be valued.
Deze leden zijn van mening dat ook onbetaalde arbeid gewaardeerd moet worden.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division supports the bill extending childcare allowance to households where one parent works and the other has a permanent Wlz care indication, but objects that excluding parents with a temporary Wlz indication lacks objective justification and advises amending the bill. The government replies that the distinction is objectively justified because temporary cases need individual tailoring via municipal social-medical support, and that the explanatory memorandum has been sharpened, so the bill is not changed.
concerns: The Council considers the distinction between permanent and temporary Wlz indications unjustified, since both groups are unable to care for their children during the indication period; the government maintains the distinction is objectively justified.
Redactional remarks of the Council have been incorporated into the bill and explanatory memorandum.

35679.s: The bill amends the 2021 budget of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds) by raising the commitment amount for general and supplementary grants to municipalities to €27.746.260.000 and adding €19 million in expenditure and revenue as a first incidental supplementary budget for corona measures. It takes effect on 1 January 2021 and applies retroactively if published later.
q: Amendment of the 2021 budget of the municipal fund (B) (1st incidental supplementary budget on corona measures)
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het gemeentefonds (B) voor het jaar 2021 (1e incidentele suppletoire begroting inzake coronamaatregelen)

35769.s: The bill shortens the maximum contractual payment term between large companies and small or medium-sized enterprises from 60 to 30 days in the Civil Code, with a transitional rule for existing contracts. The explanatory memorandum also discusses a possible future public supervisor, but only to be explored through an ACM reporting point for one year.
35769.j: The memorandum justifies the shorter payment term by better payment behaviour, and it defers any public supervision until a one-year exploration via an ACM reporting point has been evaluated.
q: It is therefore desirable to first map how willing harmed SME entrepreneurs are to report and what the nature and scale of the signals received are, before deciding whether public supervision is appropriate.

Daarom is het wenselijk dat eerst in kaart wordt gebracht hoe groot de meldingsbereidheid van benadeelde mkb-ondernemers is en wat de aard en omvang van de ontvangen signalen is, alvorens wordt besloten of publiek toezicht opportuun is.

parties: Asks how the ACM complaints point will work, whether a public supervisor will be needed, and whether Betaalme.nu was the right body given its limited results.
What will this complaints point look like? Will this complaints point be immediately available once the law takes effect?
Hoe zal dit meldpunt eruit gaan zien? Is dit meldpunt direct beschikbaar zodra de wet ingaat?
Asks why the bill omits an evaluation clause contrary to the ATR advice and questions how the complaints point and its success will be assessed.
These members ask why, contrary to the ATR advice, the proposal did not opt for an evaluation clause.</br>
Deze leden vragen waarom er, in tegenstelling tot het advies van de ATR, in het voorstel niet voor is gekozen een evaluatiebepaling op te nemen.
Asks whether a two-year rather than one-year complaints period is more suitable, whether the ACM should report periodically, and whether accountants should report late payments.
They ask whether two years would not be a more suitable period.
Zij vragen of twee jaar geen geschiktere termijn is.
Asks whether shortening the term is sufficient, and whether periodic ACM reporting and an accountant reporting duty should be added.
Can specific attention be given to introducing periodic reporting by the Authority for Consumers and Markets and a reporting duty for accountants at companies that regularly exceed payment terms?

Kan specifiek worden in gegaan op het instellen van een periodieke rapportage van de Autoriteit Consument en Markt en een meldplicht voor accountants bij bedrijven die regelmatig betaaltermijnen overschrijden?
Asks whether complainants can submit invoices as evidence, whether the complaints point will be widely communicated, and whether it should cover other trading relationships as ATR advised.
Will the government act on this?
Gaat de regering hier gevolg aan geven?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State issued an opinion on a bill amending Book 6 of the Civil Code to shorten the statutory payment term to 30 days, raising no substantive remarks and advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The Staatssecretaris forwarded the advice and the bill to the Crown, with no substantive reply needed since no remarks were made.

35787.s: The bill formally removes the two additional articles (additionele artikelen I and II) of the Dutch Constitution that were previously worked out, as proposed in the second reading of a constitutional amendment. It is a constitutional change requiring parliamentary approval in the second reading after the 2020 declaration law.
q: The additional articles I and II of the Constitution lapse.
De additionele artikelen I en II van de Grondwet vervallen.

parties: No questions for the government on the bill to remove the additional articles.
This bill does not give the members of the VVD faction any reason to ask the government questions.
Dit wetsvoorstel geeft de leden van de VVD-fractie geen aanleiding tot het stellen van vragen aan de regering.
Welcomes the proposal to remove the additional articles and has no further questions.
They have no further questions in this regard.
Zij hebben in dit verband geen nadere vragen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a proposed constitutional amendment to remove additional articles that have been implemented, and raised no remarks. The minister's reply confirms the government will submit the bill to the Tweede Kamer as advised.

35796.s: This bill amends the 2021 departmental budget of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (5th supplementary budget on forgiveness of public debts), changing the appropriations and effective from 12 April 2021. It does not delegate rule-making power or shift power away from checks on the executive.
q: The budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport for the year 2021 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport voor het jaar 2021wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35868.s: The bill amends the eIDAS-related recognition rules for digital identification means and access services, letting the Minister refuse, change, suspend or withdraw recognition on expanded grounds such as data protection design, open source use, and national security. It also adds delegations to general administrative orders (AMvB) setting detailed rules on these grounds and procedures.
35868.j: The memorandum justifies the AMvB delegations by stating that detailed rules on the refusal grounds, procedure and documentation will be set by general administrative order, including a period for providers to adapt before withdrawal.
q: Detailed rules on applying the grounds in the sixth paragraph, the recognition, amendment, suspension or withdrawal procedure will be set by general administrative order.

Bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur worden nadere regels gesteld over de toepassing van de gronden, genoemd in het zesde lid, de procedure van erkenning, wijziging, schorsing of intrekking
d: rules on recognition grounds and withdrawal procedure
recognition procedure, certificate of conformity, conformity assessment body requirements
procedure for amendment, suspension or withdrawal of recognition
p: Allows the Minister to refuse recognition on open-ended grounds of serious reasons, including vaguely defined threats to state security or the reliability of the electronic services system.
Lets the Minister amend, suspend or withdraw recognition when any refusal ground applies, extending executive power over recognised providers.
Gives the Minister discretionary grounds to refuse recognition, including the open-ended serious-reasons clause and an open-source assessment left to his judgment.

parties: Asks whether the novelle changes privacy by design, the trading ban and open source, or only moves them from AMvB to statute, and requests implementation test results.

As regards privacy by design, the trading ban and open source, is anything in this bill regulated differently from the bill accepted by the Tweede Kamer and now before the Eerste Kamer, or is it only proposed to regulate these points by statute instead of AMvB?

Wordt als het gaat om privacy by design, verhandelverbod en open source in het onderhavige wetsvoorstel iets anders geregeld dan in het wetsvoorstel dat in de Tweede Kamer is aanvaard en nu in de Eerste Kamer ligt 1 ?
Objects to repeated delegation to AMvBs and agrees with the Raad van State that overly abstract statutes create uncertainty about core elements.

These members see that the government, in amending the bill, repeatedly chooses to delegate provisions via AMvBs.; they agree with the Raad van State that overly abstract laws create uncertainty about the consequences of core elements.
Deze leden zien dat de regering in de wijziging van het voorstel meerdere keren kiest voor delegatie bepaling door middel van AMvB's.
Asks why fewer technology-dependent provisions were included despite Raad van State advice, and why the Van der Molen motion implementation cannot be done now.
These members ask the government why more technology-dependent provisions have not been included in the bill, as the Raad van State advisory division recommended.
Deze leden vragen de regering waarom er niet meer techniek-afhankelijke bepalingen in het wetsvoorstel zijn opgenomen, zoals de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State heeft geadviseerd.
Argues the bill should contain more safeguards on digitalisation and asks the government to act on Raad van State recommendations on accountability and data use.
Said members ask for the government's justification for not further extending the law with more safeguards concerning digitalisation.
Genoemde leden vragen naar de motivering van de regering om de wet niet verder uit te breiden met meer waarborgen rondom digitalisering.
Notes Raad van State techniekonafhankelijkheid advice was not fully followed, leaving detail to lower governments, and questions whether enforcement resources are sufficient.
The aforementioned members note that the Raad van State's advice on technology independence has not been fully incorporated.
De voornoemde leden merken immers op dat de adviezen van de Raad van State niet in de volledigheid zijn meegenomen betreffende de techniekonafhankelijkheid.
Asks how other EU states implemented eIDAS private identification means, whether the government's approach is proportionate, and how the minister decides on recognition of providers.
What balance has been struck between the interests of both parties?
Welke afweging is gemaakt tussen de belangen van beide partijen?
Warns provinces lack clarity on the scope of supervision of municipalities and compensation for new tasks, citing a critical Berenschot report that the provincial supervisory task is not feasible.
The specific supervisory task (article 17 paragraph 3) for provinces on compliance with the Wdo is currently not feasible.
De specifieke toezichtstaak (artikel 17 lid 3) voor provincies op de naleving van de Wdo is nu niet uitvoerbaar.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a novelle to the Wet digitale overheid, raising concerns that privacy by design, the no-commercial-use rule for login data, and open source are insufficiently defined, and that too much is delegated to lower regulation. The government's nader rapport accepts most points, committing to amend the bill and AMvB, clarify the explanatory memorandum, and move central elements into the statute.
concerns: Privacy by design is too vaguely defined and the criterion for refusing recognition of login means needs precision, which the government will provide via AMvB referring to the latest state of the art.

The no-revenue-from-user-data rule is worded too narrowly ('verhandelen of verstrekken') and does not exclude all forms of commercial exploitation, such as targeted advertising; the government will clarify in the explanatory memorandum that general regulation of such exploitation falls outside scope.

The open source requirement is unclear in scope and the bill does not provide for gradual transition to open source, so the government will clarify application and add a power to amend or withdraw recognition.

Too much detail on the central elements of the digital infrastructure is delegated to lower regulation; the government moves some elements into the statute but argues that a technology-independent formulation with AMvB detail is appropriate.
The explanatory memorandum should be amended to clarify the open source and privacy provisions and their application.

35877.s: This bill amends the 2021 budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science through a tenth supplementary budget, adjusting the spending ceiling for the National Education Programme and adding funds for the book sector. It sets the amendments to take effect from 29 June 2021, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: The budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (VIII) for the year 2021 is amended, as shown in the statement belonging to this law.
De begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (VIII) voor het jaar 2021 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35886.s: The bill amends the Dutch ship pollution prevention act and the economic offences act to implement EU Directive 2019/883 on port reception facilities for ship waste. It mainly sets out port waste plans, waste receipts, fee obligations and reporting duties, and moves detailed rules into lower regulations.
35886.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the delegations by saying the directive provisions involve no policy trade-offs and that rules fit logically into existing general administrative orders and ministerial regulations.
q: This only concerns directive provisions that require no policy-related trade-offs.
Dit heeft enkel betrekking op richtlijnbepalingen die geen beleidsinhoudelijke afwegingen vergen.
d: port reception facilities, manner of waste delivery, waste handling procedures
content, adoption, publication and validity of port waste plans
waste receipts, SafeSeaNet reporting and exemptions
registration and provision of port waste data
calculation of indirect fees, exemptions and cost-recovery cases
minister may exempt ship operators from indirect fee
timing and manner of ship notifications, data retention, exemptions
conditions allowing ships to sail on without discharging waste; minister exemptions
designated substances to be delivered to reception facilities
p: The minister may grant ship operators exemptions from the indirect waste fee in cases set by general administrative order.
The minister may exempt ship operators from the duty to discharge all ship waste in cases set out in the order.
The minister may exempt operators of unmanned reception facilities from the receipt obligation.

parties: Asks why fees are not differentiated by ship size and how dumping of excess waste to avoid costs will be prevented.
These members ask how it will be prevented that waste exceeding the maximum capacity is dumped at sea to avoid extra costs.
Deze leden vragen hoe zal worden voorkomen dat afval dat de maximale capaciteit overstijgt, gedumpt wordt op zee om extra kosten te vermijden.
Strongly supports the implementation and has no further questions.
These members are very positive about the bill, which aims to increase the effectiveness of policy to curb pollution by ships.
Deze leden staan zeer positief tegenover de strekking van de wetswijziging, welke erop gericht is de doeltreffendheid te vergroten van het beleid om verontreiniging door schepen terug te dringen.
Asks whether municipalities and small ports can carry out the Havenafvalplan task and enforcement, and how many ports lack a valid plan.
Does the government recognise the risk that people are unaware of this task or that a municipality lacks the knowledge or capacity to carry it out?
Onderkent de regering het risico dat men zich niet bewust is van deze taak of dat een gemeente te weinig kennis respectievelijk capaciteit heeft om deze uit te voeren?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the Implementation Act for the second EU port reception facilities directive, raising no substantive remarks and recommending submission to the House of Representatives. The minister's reply reports two drafting adjustments: removing 'geaggregeerd' from article 6c so enforcement remains possible for ships not obliged to report to SafeSeaNet, and a textual change from 'in' to 'aan' SafeSeaNet in article 6b.
concerns: The minister made a textual change from 'in' to 'aan' SafeSeaNet in article 6b as a technical improvement suggested in the advice.

35895.s: The bill amends the 2021 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport by a 10th incidental supplementary budget related to COVID-19 measures, adding about 118 million euro in expenditure. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and makes the law effective from 28 July 2021, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: We have ... resolved ... The budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport for 2021 is amended
Wij ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport voor het jaar 2021 wordt gewijzigd

35949.s: The bill clarifies the statutory definition of dairy cattle (melkvee) under the Fertilisers Act and its phosphate rights system, exempting certain young stock from phosphate rights. It also allows up to 100 kg of phosphate rights to be leased without levy per year, and enables a general administrative order to permit levy-free temporary transfers for stable renovation or relocation near Natura 2000 areas.
35949.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by saying the detailed conditions are technical and can be set by order, giving farmers flexibility in managing phosphate rights.
q: By general administrative order it may be made possible that no levy applies to the temporary transfer of phosphate rights back and forth in such situations, provided all conditions and restrictions set in that order are met.

Bij algemene maatregel van bestuur kan het in dergelijke situaties mogelijk worden gemaakt dat over de daarmee samenhangende tijdelijke overgang van de fosfaatrechten heen en terug geen afroming plaatsvindt, mits wordt voldaan aan alle voorwaarden en beperkingen die in die algemene maatregel van bestuur worden gesteld.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel C (artikel 32a, vierde lid)
levy-free phosphate rights transfer for renovation or relocation
Artikel I, onderdeel B (artikel 21b, vierde lid)
conditions for exemption of young stock from phosphate rights
Artikel I, onderdeel F (artikel 32a, vijfde lid)
conditions or restrictions on notifications of 100 kg lease transfers
p: Artikel I, onderdeel F (artikel 32a, vierde lid)
Allows a general administrative order to set aside the levy-free transfer limit for stable renovation or relocation, subject to conditions to be set by that order.

parties: Asks about the timing, retroactive effect of the definition change, and whether the 100 kg lease cap could later be raised once the national manure ceiling is met.
These members ask whether this clarification, with retroactive effect, has positive or negative consequences for individual dairy or beef farmers.
Dit brengt deze leden tot de vraag of deze verduidelijking met terugwerkende kracht positieve, dan wel negatieve gevolgen heeft voor individuele melk-, dan wel vleesveehouders.
Asks for the correspondence with the European Commission supporting the claim that no new state-aid notification is needed, and how repeated small annual leasing is prevented.
Can the government share with the House the correspondence between civil servants that could confirm this view?
Kan de regering de correspondentie delen die tussen de ambtelijke staf heeft plaatsgevonden die deze notie kan bevestigen voor de Kamer?
Questions why information on the scope of the state-aid decision is treated as confidential and not shared with the Raad van State and the House.
If there is no reason the scope of the state-aid decision cannot be sent to the Raad van State, the House and the foundation, when will the government send it to the Raad van State and the House?

Als er geen enkele reden is waarom de scope van het staatssteunbesluit met betrekking tot het fosfaatrechtenstelsel niet naar de Raad van State, de Kamer en de Stichting Fosfaatknelgevallen gestuurd mag worden, wanneer stuurt de regering dit naar de Raad van State en de Kamer?
Asks for analysis of financial effects and whether a fixed kilogram threshold versus a percentage yields different outcomes.
These members ask the government whether it actually assessed what this bill would have meant for farmers over the past year had it already been in force.

Deze leden vragen de regering of ook daadwerkelijk is geïnventariseerd wat het bijvoorbeeld voor het afgelopen jaar en de boeren had betekend als het voorliggende wetsvoorstel reeds in werking was getreden.
Opposes the lease exemption and narrowing of the melkvee definition as weakening the phosphate-rights tool and wasting public money on buyouts.
Levying phosphate rights on transactions is an effective and fair way to shrink manure production.
Het afromen van fosfaatrechten bij transacties is namelijk een effectieve en rechtvaardige manier om de mestproductie te laten krimpen.

Asks what was communicated to the European Commission about the scope and whether formal approval exists, to prevent future state-aid problems, and requests the notification form and Commission replies.
These members would like to receive the notification form in which the government described the phosphate rights system and the government's replies to the Commission's questions.
Deze leden ontvangen graag het meldingsformulier waarin de regering het fosfaatrechtenstelsel beschreven heeft en de antwoorden van de regering in reactie op vragen van de Commissie.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised reconsidering a bill amending the Meststoffenwet on the phosphate rights regime, because it was unclear whether EU state aid approval by the European Commission was still valid for the proposed changes, and advised consulting the Commission before submission. The government's reply states that informal consultation showed no new state aid notification is needed, the explanatory memorandum was adjusted accordingly, and an additional delegated basis for a further exception to the manure-removal obligation was added.
concerns: The Afdeling flagged uncertainty whether the proposed changes to the phosphate rights regime require renewed EU state aid notification and advised consulting the Commission first.
The Afdeling advised clarifying in the explanatory memorandum the outcome of consultations with the Commission and how the changes relate to the Commission's approval decision.

35958.s: The bill sets rules for the processing of data, including personal data, by the Minister of Justice and Security to coordinate counter-terrorism and national security policy and to produce analyses of trends and phenomena. It defines the coordinating tasks, permits data sharing with and from other government bodies, and sets retention periods, pseudonymisation duties, audits and restrictions on data subjects' rights.
35958.j: The memorandum justifies the powers by the need for a single coordinating body and a common policy framework against fragmented counter-terrorism efforts, and by the need to protect national security under the GDPR and ECHR.
q: The regime laid down in these laws is not broken by this proposal.
Het in deze wetten opgenomen regime wordt niet doorbroken met dit voorstel.
d: technical, personnel and organisational measures for data processing
content and manner of data protection audits
p: Gives the Minister a broad coordinating and analytical mandate over counter-terrorism and national security information, with limits on investigating persons or organisations.
Allows the Minister to collect, combine and share personal data from public sources and other government bodies, subject to necessity, pseudonymisation and retention limits.
Permits restriction of data subjects' rights and allows notification to be withheld where it would defeat the purpose of the restriction.

parties: Asks how the NCTV's analysis and coordination tasks differ from the AIVD's and how local authorities use its analyses, and about the sources of its own open-source research.
Can the government explain how the NCTV's task of providing decentralised authorities with a trend or phenomenon analysis differs from the AIVD's task?
Kan de regering aangeven hoe de taak van de NCTV, te weten decentrale overheden te voorzien van een trend- of fenomeenanalyse (als product), verschilt van de taak van de AIVD?
Finds the necessity of the powers unsubstantiated and their limits insufficient, and asks who oversees open-source research and how the bill's scope is bounded.
They note that the necessity of the powers created by this bill is insufficiently substantiated and that the powers are insufficiently limited.
Zij constateren dat de noodzaak van de bevoegdheden die met dit wetsvoorstel worden gecreëerd onvoldoende wordt onderbouwd en dat de bevoegdheden onvoldoende worden begrensd.
Asks about the practical need for the bill, its effect on bureaucracy, and how municipalities become aware of threats.
These members ask whether it is correct that this law also helps prevent bureaucracy among the various partners concerned with national security, such as duplicating the same work.

De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen of het klopt dat deze wet mede ervoor zorgt dat de bureaucratie voor de verschillende partners die zich bezighouden met de nationale veiligheid, denk bijvoorbeeld aan het dubbel doen van hetzelfde werk, wordt voorkomen?
Worries the NCTV's role has grown beyond its original mandate, that the short consultation was inadequate, and that oversight should be by the CTIVD under the Wiv rather than weaker safeguards.
If there are tasks in the context of national security, and the government does seem to explicitly choose that, then oversight by the CTIVD under the Wiv should be chosen.

Als er taken zijn in het kader van nationale veiligheid, en daar lijkt de regering toch nadrukkelijk voor te kiezen, dan zou voor het toezicht door de CTIVD in het kader van de Wiv moeten worden gekozen.
Doubts the bill sets clearly bounded limits, citing the Data Protection Authority's view that it resembles a blank cheque, and asks whether the DPA was consulted.
The AP wrote in response to the draft bill that on the scope and nature of personal data processing it has 'too much the character of a blank cheque'.
De AP schrijft in reactie op het conceptwetsvoorstel dat dat wetsvoorstel op het punt van omvang en aard van de verwerkingen van persoonsgegevens «te veel het karakter van een vrijbrief» heeft.
Argues the bill legitimises unlawful surveillance practices, that the NCTV should not hold standalone data powers overlapping with intelligence services, and calls for strict external oversight.
These members note that this bill sets no limits on the practices identified, but instead provides a legal basis to continue, as it now appears, on the old, unlawful footing.

Deze leden constateren dat dit wetsvoorstel geen grenzen stelt aan gesignaleerde praktijken, maar juist voorziet in een rechtsgrondslag om, zoals het er nu op lijkt, op de oude, onrechtmatige voet voort te gaan.
Asks how the Data Protection Authority can supervise effectively, why retention is five years, and how the broad grounds for sensitive data are justified.
They ask the government to explain why it does not adopt a retention period of, for example, one or three years.
Zij vragen de regering aan te geven waarom niet wordt overgegaan tot een bewaartermijn van bijvoorbeeld één of drie jaar.
Worries about the NCTV conducting its own open-source trend analysis, that the Data Protection Authority lacks national security expertise, and that analyses could become person-focused.
Although the AP specialises in supervising the processing of personal data, it lacks this specialisation and mandate when it comes to the broader national security domain.
Hoewel de AP gespecialiseerd is in het houden van toezicht op de verwerking van persoonsgegevens, mist de AP deze specialisatie en mandaat wanneer het gaat om het bredere nationale veiligheidsdomein.

Stresses that the bill puts Article 10 of the Constitution (privacy) too much at risk and that unclear limits on open-source collection and retention need addressing, in line with the Council of State.
The bill in its current form puts Article 10 too much at stake.
Het wetsvoorstel in zijn huidige vorm brengt Artikel 10 te veel in het geding.
Views the bill as legitimising illegal NCTV spying on activists and Muslim organisations and as a step toward a surveillance society, calling for it to be withdrawn.
This member sees this bill as a dangerous step toward an undemocratic society in which freedom of expression and the right to demonstrate are at stake.
Dit lid ziet dit wetsvoorstel als een gevaarlijke stap naar een ondemocratische samenleving waarin vrijheid van meningsuiting en demonstratierecht op het spel staan.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a nota van wijziging to a bill regulating NCTV processing of personal data for terrorism coordination and national security, raising concerns on necessity and subsidiarity of data processing, the scope of the data-sharing restriction, and the proposed supervision provision. The government's nader rapport accepts most points by clarifying the explanatory memorandum, but retains the supervision article for political reasons, reflecting the Afdeling's legal view while disagreeing on its value.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for concrete explanation of when NCTV data processing and analysis is necessary, given subsidiarity and proportionality, and the government clarified situations in the memorandum.

The Afdeling asked for clarification of the limitation on disclosing statements of persons in connection with trends or phenomena, and the government clarified the meaning of uitingen but kept the restriction's rationale in the explanatory note.
The Afdeling asked the explanation of personal data, anonymisation and pseudonymisation to be elaborated, and the government added explanation with examples.

The Afdeling advised deleting proposed article 5a on supervision as superfluous given existing AP and Inspectie JenV powers, but the government retained it to reflect the parliamentary wish for strengthened oversight.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering advised on a draft law giving legal basis to the NCTV's coordination and analysis tasks on terrorism and national security, including processing of personal data from public online sources, and advised against submitting it unless amended. The government's nader rapport accepted most points, amending the scope, public-source research limits, retention, supervision, sensitive data, delegation and Caribbean applicability.
concerns: Processing of personal data via public online sources affects privacy under Article 10 of the Constitution and requires a fuller weighing of interests in the explanatory memorandum; government added explanation.

The scope and task descriptions of the bill are insufficiently clear and consistent, with undefined terms and differing formulations; government revised articles 2 and 3 and the explanatory memorandum.

The vague 'min of meer volledig beeld' limit on public-source research is inadequate; government replaced it with a ban on automated profiling tools and a privacy audit, rather than the original criterion.

A five-year retention period is relatively long and may be too long for data gathered incidentally; government kept five years but changed the starting point and allowed extension with ministerial consent.
Supervision by the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens needs clearer arrangements; government sent the audit proposal to the AP, but did not agree to forward audit results.
Processing of sensitive and criminal data needs separate justification of necessity and proportionality; government narrowed and clarified the sensitive data grounds.

Rules on technical and organizational safeguards were delegated too broadly, with no reason given; government removed the possibility of delegating to the minister and added a prohibition on profiling systems.
The bill's exclusion of Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba is unexplained; government explained the choice in the explanatory memorandum.

35967.s: The bill merges the municipalities of Brielle, Hellevoetsluis and Westvoorne into a new municipality called Voorne aan Zee and dissolves the three former municipalities. It makes conforming amendments to the Crisis- en herstelwet, Kieswet, Wet maatregelen woningmarkt 2014 II, Wet op de rechterlijke indeling and Wet veiligheidsregio's, and sets entry into force by royal decree.
q: This act enters into force at a time to be determined by royal decree.
Deze wet treedt in werking op een bij koninklijk besluit te bepalen tijdstip.
d: fixing the date of entry into force by royal decree

parties: Welcomes the bill as a municipality-initiated merger and raises no remarks or questions.
The bill gives these members no reason to make remarks or ask questions.
Het wetsvoorstel geeft deze leden geen aanleiding tot het maken van opmerkingen en het stellen van vragen.
Asks how resident and organisation ideas were taken into account and how the financial differences between the municipalities will be bridged.
Can the government explain how the municipalities will bridge the difference in financial position so that this does not pose a risk to good cooperation?
Kan de regering uitleggen hoe de gemeenten het verschil in financiële positie gaan overbruggen zodat dit niet een risico voor een goede samenwerking vormt?
Supports merger from below but questions whether citizen involvement was adequate given COVID restrictions and whether the bottom-up process is sufficiently secured.
Is the bottom-up process sufficiently safeguarded?
Is het proces van onderop voldoende geborgd?
Objects that mergers are imposed by circumstances rather than arising from residents, asks why no referendum was held, and questions the representativeness of consultations.
They further ask whether the government considers research representative if only people who have already indicated they want to take part in municipal research, as in Westvoorne, are surveyed.
Verder vragen zij of de regering onderzoek representatief acht als enkel mensen worden bevraagd die zelf al hebben aangegeven mee te willen doen aan gemeentelijke onderzoeken, zoals in Westvoorne.
Asks how many joint arrangements are involved and whether fewer councillors will reduce democratic involvement in joint regulations.
They further ask whether the government shares the concern that with fewer councillors, involvement in decision-making in joint arrangements will also become less intensive.
Voorts vragen zij of de regering de zorg deelt dat wanneer er minder raadsleden zijn, ook de betrokkenheid bij de besluitvorming in gemeenschappelijke regelingen minder intensief zal worden.

35975-IIB.s: This second supplementary budget bill amends the 2021 budget for the other high state bodies, the Governors' cabinets and the Electoral Council, adjusting appropriations and receipts by thousands of euros with retroactive effect from 1 December 2021. The explanatory memorandum details the budget changes for the Council of State, including wage adjustments, funding for the Open Government Act, and lower receipts due to delayed case intake.
q: Funds have been added to the Council of State's budget for the implementation and execution of the Open Government Act.
Er zijn middelen aan de begroting van de Raad van State toegevoegd voor de implementatie en uitvoering van de Wet Open Overheid.

35976.s: The bill establishes a National Growth Fund (Nationaal Groeifonds) as a budget fund to finance investments in knowledge, research and innovation, and infrastructure to strengthen the Netherlands' long-term earning capacity. It lets the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate grant subsidies from the fund, sets up an advisory committee, and requires a multi-year programme and an evaluation report.
35976.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed for flexible, efficient subsidy design across a broad fund and cites the need to strengthen parliamentary control after criticism from the Court of Audit and the Council of State.
q: The bill therefore contains a legal basis for the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate to grant subsidies for activities that fit the fund's purpose.
Het onderhavige wetsvoorstel bevat daarom een grondslag voor de Minister van Economische Zaken en Klimaat om subsidie te verstrekken voor activiteiten die passen binnen het doel van het fonds.
d: detailed rules on fund expenditure and subsidy conditions, procedures and enforcement
detailed rules on fund expenditure and subsidy conditions, procedures and enforcement
task, independence and accountability of the advisory committee
minister may refuse, reduce or revoke subsidies in breach of treaty obligations
p: The minister may refuse, reduce or retroactively revoke subsidies, and the usual rules on revocation and interest in the General Administrative Law Act do not apply, limiting beneficiaries' legal protection.
The fund's purpose and criteria are stated broadly, and a later amount to be set may be fixed by the executive to reach a substantial effect, leaving the executive wide discretion over spending.
Appeals against subsidy decisions go directly to the College van Beroep voor het bedrijfsleven in first and only instance, which shortens the normal appeal route.

parties: Asks for an overview of unspent fund money and how the fund's project proposals are assessed, and whether parties can appeal the advisory committee's opinion.
The VVD members note that unspent fund money is carried over without limit to the following budget year.
De leden van de VVD-fractie lezen dat niet-bestede gelden van het fonds onbeperkt worden meegenomen naar het daaropvolgende begrotingsjaar.
Worried about how the fund performed in its first tranche and the criticism from the Raad van State and the scientific review; asks why all projects are not subject to a cost-benefit analysis.

These members, however, are also concerned about how the National Growth Fund functioned in its first tranche and the criticisms raised by the Council of State and the scientific review, among others.

Deze leden hebben echter ook zorgen over de manier waarop het Nationaal Groeifonds in de eerste tranche heeft gefunctioneerd en de kritiekpunten die onder andere de Raad van State en de wetenschapstoets hebben voortgebracht.
Asks for clarity on the fund's powers and whether parliament has budget rights, and asks that delegation provisions always involve the States General.
The SP members ask the government whether the House of Representatives has budget rights.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen de regering of er een budgetrecht is van de Tweede Kamer.
Asks how the fund will be evaluated, questions the focus on GDP growth, and asks how the advisory committee will weigh distributional effects.
The GroenLinks members ask the government to explain how it will act on the scientific review's recommendations on evaluating the National Growth Fund.

De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie vragen de regering uiteen te zetten op welke manier aan de aanbevelingen uit de wetenschapstoets ten aanzien van de evaluatie van het Nationaal Groeifonds invulling gegeven gaat worden.
Opposes the GDP-growth focus of the fund and argues for broad welfare and climate criteria.
Economic growth is the problem, not the solution.
Economische groei is namelijk het probleem, niet de oplossing.
Welcomes strengthening of parliament's budget right and authorisation function, but asks about the pending amendment and subsidy regulation and whether they will be submitted to parliament.
The CDA members welcome the bill and appreciate that the government is meeting parliament's wish to strengthen its budget right and authorisation function.
De leden van de CDA-fractie verwelkomen het wetsvoorstel en waarderen dat de regering hiermee tegemoetkomt aan de wens van het parlement om zijn budgetrecht en autorisatiefunctie te versterken.
Asks how the criteria in article 2 are weighed, how added value over regular policy is secured, and how outsiders' chances are promoted.
How is it ensured that funds are only made available to projects that enable a scale-up, these members ask.
Hoe wordt geborgd dat alleen middelen ter beschikking worden gesteld aan projecten waarmee een schaalsprong mogelijk wordt gemaakt, zo vragen deze leden.
Supports moving regular infrastructure policy out of the fund but asks about the timing of the amendment, budgetary effects and the missing time horizon in the law.
The ChristenUnie members consider it a good development that regular policy such as infrastructure investment is being removed from the Growth Fund.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie vinden het een goede ontwikkeling dat regulier beleid zoals investeringen in infrastructuur uit het Groeifonds worden gehaald.
Finds the fund's purpose too vague for parliament to control and proposes testing against broad welfare rather than GDP contribution.
As a result, it is unclear to parliament what exactly it is agreeing to, and it has hardly any yardstick to check whether the fund has been effective.
Daarmee is het voor het parlement onduidelijk waarmee het precies instemt en heeft het nauwelijks een maatstaf om te controleren of het fonds effectief is geweest.
Asks how the advisory committee's independence is guaranteed given ministerial powers to appoint, dismiss and suspend members, and asks for timely transmission of advice to parliament.

They do wonder, however, to what extent the independence of this committee can be guaranteed if the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate and the Minister of Finance are given powers to appoint, dismiss and suspend committee members.

Wel vragen zij zich af in hoeverre de onafhankelijkheid van deze commissie gegarandeerd kan worden als de Minister van Economische Zaken en Klimaat en de Minister van Financiën de bevoegdheden krijgen om leden van commissie te benoemen, te ontslaan en te schorsen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the Nationaal Groeifonds bill lacks a clear purpose, leaves parliament without a clear view of funds transferred via departmental routes, has unclear added value in co-managing ministers, and has unclear relevance for Caribbean Netherlands. The government's reply accepts most points: it defines 'duurzaam verdienvermogen', adds substantive criteria to the bill, adds NGF annexes to departmental budgets and reports, justifies the joint ministerial responsibility, and explains the Caribbean threshold without exempting it.
concerns: Parliament's budget right requires a clear purpose and substantive criteria in the law; the government added a definition and criteria to the bill.
Funds transferred via departmental budgets must stay visible to parliament; the government added separate coding, NGF annexes and a multi-year programme.
Joint management by the Ministers of Economic Affairs and Finance needs justification; the government explains the choice but retains joint responsibility on the basis of earlier reasoning.
The EUR 30 million threshold may not fit Caribbean Netherlands; the government declined a lower threshold and will examine combining proposals with European Netherlands.
Redactional remarks were incorporated, including clarifying the relation to article 4:35 Awb and the scope of the two-year evaluation.

35985.s: The bill amends the Competition Act's market-and-government rules to make them permanent by removing the sunset clause, tightens the public-interest exception with motivation requirements and a pre-decision market consultation, and exempts free release of open source software from integral cost-pricing. It also requires a five-yearly evaluation of public-interest decisions and extends certain provisions to Caribbean-part and foreign public authorities.
35985.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies removing the horizon date by evaluation findings that the Act reduces unfair competition, and justifies the stricter process by case law and the need for early input from entrepreneurs.
q: Because the usefulness of the Act in reducing unequal competition has been demonstrated, this bill therefore removes the current horizon provision from the market and government act.
Omdat het nut van de wet op het verminderen van ongelijke concurrentie is aangetoond, zal dit wetsvoorstel daarom de huidige horizonbepaling in de wet markt en overheid schrappen.
d: motivation elements and evaluation elements for public-interest decisions
transitional application of evaluation and motivation rules to earlier decisions
p: Public authorities may depart from market-conduct rules for economic activity in the general interest, decided by the competent executive body, subject to motivation and consultation requirements.
The removal of the statutory horizon date makes the public-interest exception permanent, subject to five-yearly self-evaluation by the deciding authority, which is itself appealable.
Extends the exception for public bodies to authorities of Caribbean parts of the Kingdom and of other states, widening who may be favoured without the market-conduct rules.

parties: Asks whether bodies deciding themselves which activities fall under the general-interest exception should be replaced by an independent body such as the ACM, given unfair competition for entrepreneurs.
public bodies may themselves decide that an economic activity takes place in the general interest.
bestuursorganen zelf mogen beslissen dat een economische activiteit in het algemeen belang plaatsvindt
Asks whether the proposed motivation requirements match recent case law of the CBb, which requires public bodies to map and compensate harm to third parties.
public bodies must carefully map the disadvantage to third parties when adopting a general-interest decision.
bestuursorganen bij de vaststelling van een algemeenbelangbesluit zorgvuldig het nadeel van derden in kaart moeten brengen
Asks who makes the balancing assessment of general-interest benefits against harm to entrepreneurs, and how consultations are supervised.
Can the government make clear who in practice will make this weighing?
Kan de regering duidelijk maken wie in de praktijk deze afweging zal maken?
Sceptical of the need for the bill, fears bureaucracy and obstacles for municipalities, especially sport, through five-yearly evaluation and tightened motivation.
The SP does not want the general-interest decision to be stripped down or to lead to further bureaucracy for governments.
De leden van de SP-fractie willen niet dat het algemeenbelangbesluit wordt uitgekleed of verder tot bureaucratie gaat leiden voor overheden.
Supports the aim of preventing unfair competition but asks whether municipalities can still act for general interest without excessive administrative burden.
These members therefore ask whether they are right that the bill is drafted so that bodies can still undertake economic activities without excessive administrative burden.
Daarom vragen deze leden of zij het goed zien, dat de wet zo voorgesteld wordt dat het voor bestuursorganen inderdaad mogelijk blijft om zonder excessieve administratieve lasten
Notes motivation for the general-interest exception is often limited and asks about case law on judicial review and the added value of an ACM role.
Governments often invoke the general-interest exception, while the motivation is usually limited.
Overheden doen vaak een beroep op de algemeenbelanguitzondering, terwijl de motivering veelal beperkt is.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill amending the Mededingingswet on rules concerning markets and government, raising no substantive remarks and only one editorial point on recent case law. The minister's nader rapport reports that the editorial remark was taken up by supplementing the section on due care and reasoning requirements and that the financial section was clarified.
concerns: The Afdeling asked that the explanatory memorandum also discuss recent case law of the Rotterdam court and the College van Beroep voor het bedrijfsleven on due care and reasoning in general-interest decisions, and the government added this.

35994.s: This second supplementary budget for 2022 amends the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport budget statement, raising spending and obligations mainly for COVID-19 measures such as a third period of the Coronabanen in de Zorg subsidy scheme and a larger National Care Reserve. The bill itself contains no delegation of rule-making power; it only adjusts budget figures and entry into force.
35994.j: The memorandum justifies the additional funds by the continuing pressure on care due to the COVID-19 pandemic, not by any new or expanded executive power.
q: Due to the ongoing pressure on care as a result of the COVID-19 pandemic, the cabinet makes €45 million available in 2022 for a third period of the Coronabanen in de Zorg subsidy scheme.
Vanwege de aanhoudende druk op de zorg als gevolg van de COVID-19 pandemie, stelt het kabinet in 2022 € 45 miljoen beschikbaar voor een derde tijdvak van de subsidieregeling Coronabanen in de Zorg.

36250-IX.s: This bill amends the 2022 departmental budget statements of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the National Debt (IXA) through a second supplementary budget, adjusting commitments, expenditure and receipts across policy and non-policy articles. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 1 December 2022, and states all amounts in thousands of euros.
36250-IX.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to reported mutations, such as commitments wrongly booked in 2021 that the Auditdienst Rijk found, and reallocations between budget items.
q: When auditing the 2021 annual report, the Auditdienst Rijk (ADR) found that commitments of €96.5 million were wrongly recorded in 2021.
Bij de controle van het jaarverslag 2021 heeft de Auditdienst Rijk (ADR) geconstateerd dat verplichtingen ter grootte van € 96,5 mln ten onrechte in het jaar 2021 zijn verantwoord.

36360-IV.s: This bill is a slotwet that formally adjusts the 2022 budget statements for Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) and the BES-fonds (H) to match realised spending. It sets the figures in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, with retroactive effect to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Thus it is that We, in joint consultation with the States General, have deemed good and resolved, as We hereby deem good and resolve
Zo is het, dat Wij met gemeen overleg der Staten-Generaal, hebben goedgevonden en verstaan, gelijk Wij goedvinden en verstaan bij deze

36360-VI.s: This slotwet amends the 2022 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Justice and Security and the budgets of its agencies to reflect actual spending and revenue. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Thus it is that We, in common consultation with the States General, have found good and resolved, as We hereby find good and resolve
Zo is het, dat Wij met gemeen overleg der Staten-Generaal, hebben goedgevonden en verstaan, gelijk Wij goedvinden en verstaan bij deze

36489.s: The bill allows Dutch private-law legal persons (NV, BV, cooperatives, associations, owners' associations) to hold fully digital general meetings, sets safeguards for electronic participation and voting, and modernises digital convocation rules. It also contains transitional rules validating certain past digitally held meetings and requires a report to parliament within five years.
36489.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by giving private legal persons flexibility to choose their own procedures, while noting the statutes cannot compel digital participation.
q: Unless the articles of association provide otherwise, the general meeting may authorise the person entitled to convene it to decide that the meeting is accessible wholly or additionally by electronic means.

Tenzij de statuten anders bepalen, kan de algemene vergadering degene die bevoegd is de algemene vergadering bijeen te roepen machtigen om te bepalen dat de algemene vergadering tevens of uitsluitend toegankelijk is langs elektronische weg.
d: authorising the convener to decide that the meeting is held wholly or partly electronically
conditions on use of the electronic communication means set in articles of association or notice
cooperative rules may deviate from the convocation rule of article 38(6) by regulation

parties: Asks why fully digital meetings should be allowed by board decision alone without a qualified majority, and worries about weakened shareholder control and accountability of the board.
Why is it not at least legally required that a majority of the general meeting be needed before the option of fully digital meetings can be recorded in the articles of association?

Waarom wordt tenminste niet wettelijk vastgelegd dat een meerderheid van de algemene vergadering nodig is voordat de mogelijkheid tot volledig digitaal vergaderen in de statuten kan worden vastgelegd?
Asks government to respond to Afdeling advice on protecting digitally less skilled citizens and on deepfake risks, and whether a protocol should be available to all participants.
The Afdeling Advisering also doubts whether the bill and its explanatory memorandum sufficiently safeguard the interests of citizens with less digital skills.
Ook de Afdeling betwijfelt of met het wetsvoorstel en de toelichting daarop de belangen van de digitaal minder vaardige burger voldoende zijn gewaarborgd.
Worries that fully digital meetings harm decision quality and shareholder participation, and asks whether members should have to explicitly consent to digital meeting options in the articles.
