Unless the articles provide otherwise, the BV, NV or VvE may convene the general meeting digitally, as article 38(6) of Book 2 of the Civil Code will now read.
Tenzij de statuten anders bepalen, zo komt nu artikel 38, lid 6 van Boek 2 BW te luiden, kan de bv, nv of VvE de algemene vergadering digitaal uitschrijven.
Asks whether a qualified majority requirement is warranted for decisions to allow fully digital meetings, to protect minority shareholders and checks within companies.
Does the government agree that a requirement for a qualified majority decision may nonetheless be appropriate, also to protect minority shareholders?
Deelt de regering de mening dat een vereiste van besluitvorming met versterkte meerderheid daarom toch op zijn plaats kan zijn, ook ter bescherming van de positie van minderheidsaandeelhouders?
Worries that members without digital access could be excluded from digital member meetings and asks how their position can be strengthened.
it cannot be ruled out that a small minority of members lacking digital skills or means would be unable to take part in a general meeting this way.
is het niet uitgesloten dat een kleine minderheid van leden die geen digitale vaardigheden of middelen heeft, op deze manier niet zou kunnen meedoen aan een ALV.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill allowing fully digital general meetings of private legal persons, raising concerns that digitally less skilled members may be excluded under the free authorisation regime for associations and VvEs, and that the explanatory memorandum does not address emergency situations such as a pandemic. The government's reply accepts the need to supplement the explanatory memorandum on both points and says emergency arrangements will be considered in the review of state emergency law.
concerns: Digitally less skilled members risk exclusion from fully digital meetings, and the explanatory memorandum should better safeguard their full participation at the authorisation stage; the government supplemented the memorandum but relies on the association to ensure participation.

The bill lacks a regime for emergency situations such as a pandemic, and the explanatory memorandum should clarify how digital meetings could still be held; the government added explanation but defers a full emergency arrangement to the state emergency law review.

36579.s: The bill gives the health inspectorate (IGJ) explicit supervision and enforcement powers over the Wabvpz data-processing rules, including orders with penalty payments and binding orders, and lets healthcare providers process the BSN of legal representatives and authorised persons. It also grants UN and European anti-torture committees access to patient records of people deprived of liberty, shortens data retention for Wmo clients, and expands Vektis and Wlz data reporting to the minister.
36579.j: The memorandum justifies the new inspectorate powers by the need for effective supervision of information security and legal certainty, and the access rights by Nederland's treaty obligations.
q: To supervise effectively, supervisory and enforcement powers are necessary.
Om effectief toezicht te houden zijn toezichts- en handhavingsmogelijkheden noodzakelijk.
d: Artikel 4 (Wabvpz, lid 2) / Artikel I, onderdeel B
processing of BSN of legal representatives
Artikel 16a (Wabvpz, mandate for extension of binding order)
p: Artikel I, onderdeel C (Wabvpz toezicht en handhaving, schriftelijk bevel)

Gives the inspectorate power to issue immediate written binding orders on health and safety grounds, valid seven days and extendable by the minister, reducing the procedural protections of providers and patients.
Artikel II, onderdeel B (artikel 24a Wkkgz, inzagerecht comités)
Overrides medical confidentiality so UN and European committees can inspect records of persons deprived of liberty, limited to what is necessary for their treaty task.
Artikel I, onderdeel B (artikel 4 lid 2 Wabvpz, BSN verwerking)
Allows healthcare providers to process the BSN of representatives to verify identity and authority, limited to what is necessary.
Artikel III en VII (Wlz en Zvw, informatieverstrekking aan Minister)
Requires Wlz-uitvoerders and health insurers to supply information to the minister for health policy, with a bar on directly identifying data.
Shortens retention of Wmo client data to seven years, which strengthens data protection.

parties: Asks why the bill bundles five parts when only two are urgent, and warns that expanding data-processing grounds risks excessive exchange and curtailed privacy.
Expansions of legal grounds for data processing must be carefully scrutinised, these members say.
Uitbreiding van grondslagen voor gegevensverwerking dienen zorgvuldig worden getoetst, aldus deze leden.
Asks how often the IGJ finds information-security shortcomings, how often it enforces, and what the limits are on committee access to dossiers and Vektis data.
These members want to know how the adopted Joseph motion, which requires the NZa to destroy HoNOS+ data, is being implemented.
Deze leden zijn benieuwd hoe het staat met de uitvoering van de aangenomen motie Joseph c.s.
Supports easier data sharing for care quality and research, but asks who decides what is 'redelijkerwijs nodig' and questions the narrow public-interest framing for Vektis data.
Care professionals can learn from each other and it is good for care seekers to have clarity about the quality of care.
Zorgverleners kunnen van elkaar leren en voor zorgvragers is het goed om duidelijkheid te hebben over de kwaliteit van zorg.

Urges great restraint in breaking professional secrecy and privacy without explicit consent, asks whether IGJ and AP roles should stay separate, and questions whether voluntary-care patients need consent-based protection.
At the same time these members consider it essential to act with great restraint when breaking professional secrecy within care.
Tegelijkertijd achten deze leden het van essentieel belang om zeer terughoudend te opereren wanneer het gaat om het doorbreken van het beroepsgeheim binnen de zorg.
Asks for justification of splitting the bill into parts a and b, and for proportionality and necessity of each data-processing ground, including alternatives.
Relays the Raad van State's warning that a better performance of statutory tasks does not justify breaking medical confidentiality, and asks the government to amend the bill to protect it.
These members therefore ask whether the government will amend the bill so that medical confidentiality remains guaranteed.
Deze leden vragen hierom of de regering het wetsvoorstel zo wil aanpassen dat het medisch beroepsgeheim gewaarborgd blijft.
Has no questions at this stage.
and have no questions on this at this moment.
en hebben hierover op dit moment geen vragen.
Notes the bill omits the legal basis for GGD-GHOR processing of uninsured persons' reports, and finds the explanation of Vektis's current and proposed powers unclear.
The SP members find the explanatory memorandum still unclear about exactly what this amendment entails on this point.
De leden van de SP-fractie achten de toelichting nog onduidelijk over wat deze wetswijziging op dit punt precies inhoudt.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the Verzamelwet gegevensverwerking VWS II, which creates legal bases for health data processing, and urged stronger justification of necessity and proportionality, especially where medical confidentiality is breached for RIVM vaccination and screening data, the Jeugdwet-Wlz overlap, and Vektis data processing. The Minister's reply splits the bill, accepts some points, and defends the remaining grounds in a limited form while adding justification to the comités and Vektis provisions.
concerns: The Afdeling said the RIVM vaccination and screening data processing breaks medical confidentiality without adequately justified necessity and proportionality, and that a notification-based opt-out may demand as much of care providers as consent does.

The Afdeling asked for a stronger, per-ground justification of necessity and proportionality where a serious public interest is invoked for processing health data, including for the comités and Vektis.
The Afdeling doubted the necessity of the Jeugdwet-Wlz samenloop data processing, citing an Nza study finding little actual overlap, and advised dropping it if it cannot be justified.
The Afdeling said the data exchange for the Wzd placement problem does not by itself solve the placement problem and asked the explanatory memorandum to address other causes.
The Afdeling advised that the categories of data to be exchanged for Wzd placement be set out in the law or in an algemene maatregel van bestuur rather than left open.
The Afdeling asked that the explanatory memorandum justify the AVG grounds for Vektis processing of health data and the appropriate safeguards required for such exceptions.

36588.s: The bill harmonises appeal routes so that substantive ACM decisions and their publication decisions go to the same court, amends the Aanbestedingswet, the Kaderwet EZK- en LNV-subsidies (adding a fraud-prevention register held by the minister), the Telecommunicatiewet communication secrecy rule and several technical corrections. It mainly restructures judicial review routes and creates a ministerial register with consequences for future subsidy applications.
36588.j: The memorandum justifies the register by preventing subsidy misuse and says consequences must be proportionate, limited to new subsidies and to a restricted set of subsidy types.
q: The register aims to prevent subsidy misuse and contains information about misuse in the subsidy process.
Het register heeft tot doel misbruik van subsidie te voorkomen en bevat informatie over misbruik bij het subsidieproces.
d: electronic submission of subsidy applications and exemptions
additional rules on subsidy fraud register
consequences of register entries for new subsidy decisions
p: The minister may keep a register of subsidy fraud suspicions and attach consequences to it for future subsidy decisions, with retention limited to three years and access restricted to designated officials.

Publication decisions by the ACM are moved to single-instance appeal before the CBb in cases where the underlying decision already has such appeal, removing one judicial instance for companies.[Note: text is in favour of consolidation; judicial review remains available.]
Communication secrecy is extended to any person and to users rather than only providers and subscribers, strengthening citizens' privacy protection against interception.

parties: The VVD has no additional comments on the bill.
The members of the VVD faction have taken note of the bill and have no additional comments.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van het voorliggende wetsvoorstel en hebben hierover geen aanvullende opmerkingen.

NSC asks about the necessity, proportionality, data security and possible algorithmic processing of misuse data in the subsidy register, and about the economic harm of exclusion from tenders even for minimal infringements.
These members ask whether the government can explain whether the data from the register will be processed by algorithms in the risk analysis for future subsidy applications.
Deze leden vragen of de regering kan toelichten of de gegevens uit het register door algoritmes worden verwerkt bij de risicoanalyse voor toekomstige subsidieaanvragen.
BBB questions the relevance of the portfolio-allocation update and asks why the Rotterdam district court should be designated for specialised matters that the CBb is competent to decide.
These members are curious about the reasons why the government wants to designate the Rotterdam district court for specialised matters over which the CBb is competent to rule.
Deze leden zijn benieuwd naar de redenen waarom de regering de rechtbank Rotterdam wil aanwijzen voor gespecialiseerde materie waar het CBb bevoegd over is om te oordelen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State raised no remarks on the draft omnibus bill (Verzamelwet EZK 20..) correcting technical defects in various Economic Affairs laws and advised submission to parliament. The Minister's nader rapport reports that the scope of the bill was clarified and that one provision of the Wet op het CBS was adjusted to align deadlines.

36625-III.s: This bill amends the 2024 departmental budget statements of the Ministry of General Affairs (IIIA) and the Oversight Committee on Intelligence and Security Services (IIIC) in a second supplementary budget. It makes a small net increase of EUR 52 thousand in the Ministry's expenditure and a EUR 1,000 thousand reduction in the Committee's budget due to underspending.
q: Underspending at the Oversight Committee on Intelligence and Security Services.
Onderuitputting bij de Commissie van Toezicht op de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten.

36669.s: This bill amends the entry-into-force article of the Belastingplan BES-eilanden 2025 so that the tax package takes effect on 1 January 2025 instead of the originally proposed date. It also provides that this amending law enters into force at the same time as the Belastingplan BES-eilanden 2025.
q: This law enters into force on 1 January 2025.
Deze wet treedt in werking met ingang van 1 januari 2025.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the draft amendment to the Belastingplan BES-eilanden 2025 and raised no remarks, advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The Staatssecretaris van Financiën forwarded the advice to the King with a short reply noting the Afdeling's lack of objections.

36678.s: The bill implements EU Directive 2022/2464 on sustainability reporting by amending the Wet toezicht accountantsorganisaties, Wet op het financieel toezicht, Burgerlijk Wetboek, Wet op het accountantsberoep and related laws so that accountants can provide assurance on sustainability reporting under the same supervisory framework as statutory audits. It sets new licensing, registration, independence, quality-control and disciplinary rules for sustainability assurance, and leaves the detailed sustainability reporting obligations to implementing general administrative orders (AMvB) under Book 2 BW.
36678.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for detailed technical rules and the short EU implementation deadline, and notes that the sustainability reporting obligations are left to a general administrative order.
q: The substantive sustainability reporting obligations for undertakings will be implemented in a general administrative order based on Book 2 of the Civil Code.
De inhoudelijke duurzaamheidsrapporteringsverplichtingen voor ondernemingen zullen worden uitgevoerd in een algemene maatregel van bestuur gebaseerd op Boek 2 van het Burgerlijk Wetboek.
d: audit committee rules for sustainability reporting at public-interest entities
additional quality-control rules for sustainability assurance firms
Artikel IV, F (artikel 2:391a lid 2 BW, referenced)
sustainability reporting content and assurance under Book 2 BW
registration notation for sustainability assurance via professional body
data required with application for sustainability assurance notation
Artikel II, O/Artikel II, HH lid 7 Wta
adjustment of the scope of supervision rules by general administrative order
p: The AFM gains power to register, suspend and remove sustainability assurance notations and to act on accountants' registration status.
AFM supervisory and investigative powers are extended to cover sustainability assurance engagements.
The disciplinary chamber and professional body gain power to suspend or remove sustainability assurance notations as sanctions.
Any interested party may sue the entity to enforce the duty to commission sustainability assurance, strengthening private enforcement.

parties: Asks how the bill benefits Dutch citizens and businesses and whether enforcement problems arise after the postponed introduction.
Does the government still foresee problems with enforcement and compliance in the postponed introduction?
Voorziet de regering nog problemen met betrekking tot handhaving en compliance bij de uitgestelde invoering?
Argues sustainability reports should be discussed at shareholder meetings and closed with a vote for full transparency, and asks about the AFM's supervisory capacity and greenwashing prevention.
These members believe full transparency requires that the CSRD sustainability report be discussed annually at the shareholders' meeting and that accountability be closed with a vote.

Deze leden zijn van mening dat voor het voor volledige transparantie noodzakelijk is om het CSRD-duurzaamheidsverslag jaarlijks op de aandeelhoudersvergadering te behandelen en dat de verantwoording over de duurzaamheidsprestaties wordt afgesloten met een stemming.

Supports strong simplification and even abolition of CSRD, criticises retroactive effect and sector standards imposed from the EU, and asks for a full overview of member state options and the timing of implementing decrees.
These members are strongly critical of the elements of CSRD that have retroactive effect.
Deze leden hebben grote kritiek op de elementen van CSRD die werking met terugwerkende kracht hebben.
Asks whether deregulation causes material loss of sustainability, whether an impact assessment was done, how parliament is involved in the AMvB, and how often reports are monitored.
In what way will the Chamber be involved in the envisaged revision of these standards by the European Commission?
Op welke manier wordt de Kamer betrokken bij de beoogde herziening hiervan door de Europese Commissie?
Asks about gender and diversity reporting requirements, competitiveness risks and possible leakage of firms to countries with fewer obligations.
To what extent does the government see structural risks arising in competitive relations with industrialised countries that do not follow far-reaching regulatory burdens on sustainability reporting?

In hoeverre ziet de regering structurele risico's ontstaan in concurrentieverhoudingen ten opzichte van geïndustrialiseerde landen die niet meegaan in vergaande regeldruk rond duurzaamheidsrapportering?
Asks how far the proposals have been weakened, whether the original purpose has been lost, and how the rules avoid becoming bureaucratic ends in themselves.
To what extent have these proposals been weakened and how is this reflected in the present implementing act?
In welke mate zijn deze voorstellen afgezwakt en hoe komt dit tot uiting in de onderhavige implementatiewet?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the bill implementing the EU sustainability reporting directive (CSRD) can proceed to the Tweede Kamer with no remarks. The government's reply (nader rapport) notes several amendments made in response to the advisory process, such as clarifying the accountant definition, third-country auditor registration, and extending a temporary appointment arrangement to fiscal year 2025.

36759.s: The bill amends the Dutch Medical Devices Act to implement EU Regulation 2024/1860 on the phased rollout of Eudamed and the duty to notify supply interruptions or discontinuations of medical devices. It requires the Minister to publish device and manufacturer information after notifications, makes violations subject to administrative fines enforced by the IGJ, and excludes the new article from the Open Government Act.
36759.j: The memorandum justifies the form delegation as following the EU-level form, and the administrative fine as the only appropriate sanction given the nature of the non-notification offence.
q: Administrative punitive enforcement is appropriate, since the context is closed and the violation is relatively minor and easy to establish.
Bestuursrechtelijke punitieve handhaving ligt in de rede, aangezien er sprake is van een besloten context en de overtreding relatief licht en eenvoudig vast te stellen is.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel A (artikel 4, derde lid Wmh)
form for notifications of supply interruptions
amending references to binding EU legal acts in the Act
p: Artikel I, onderdeel C (artikel 14, tweede lid Wmh)
The Minister may impose administrative fines up to the fifth category maximum for failures to notify supply interruptions, a new punitive power for the executive.
Placing the new article 9b on the Open Government Act annex excludes the general Woo disclosure regime for this information, so disclosure is governed solely by the special provision.

parties: Asks how the IGJ can enforce the new rules and whether it has sufficient capacity, and how individual interest balancing is made concrete and by whom.
How is it checked whether they can actually make this assessment properly?
Hoe wordt er getoetst of zij deze inschatting vervolgens daadwerkelijk naar behoren kunnen maken?
Questions whether manufacturers, who have commercial interests, are the right party to judge whether a shortage poses serious risk, and asks about risks in this assessment.
The GroenLinks-PvdA members ask whether the manufacturer is the right party to make this assessment.
De leden van de GroenLinks-PvdA-fractie vragen of de fabrikant de juiste partij is om deze afweging te maken.
Asks what notification means for healthcare providers and whether the bill affects them.
These members ask what consequences a notification has for the healthcare provider.
Deze leden vragen welke gevolgen een melding heeft voor de zorgaanbieder.
Supportive of the bill but asks for clear criteria for when a supply interruption must be reported.
It is unclear for which supply interruption a notification must be made; what are the criteria for reporting a supply interruption?
Onduidelijk is bij welke leveringsonderbreking een melding gedaan moet worden, wat zijn te criteria voor een melding van leveringsonderbreking?
Asks whether a six-month advance notice is sufficient for actors to take risk-mitigating measures and whether the fine is high enough to achieve timely notification.
However, these members ask whether a minimum period of six months in advance is sufficient for the relevant actors to take risk-reducing measures.
Echter vragen genoemde leden of een termijn van minimaal zes maanden vooraf voldoende is voor de desbetreffende actoren om risicobeperkende maatregelen te treffen.
Has no questions for the government.
These members have no questions for the government.
Genoemde leden hebben geen vragen aan de regering.
Asks for a fuller justification of why public disclosure outweighs the Woo exemption grounds, and how the provision goes beyond the regulation.
In particular why the interest of disclosure, according to the government, weighs more heavily than the exemption grounds in Article 5.1 of the Open Government Act (Woo).
Met name waarom het belang van openbaarmaking hier volgens de regering zwaarder weegt dan de uitzonderingsgronden in artikel 5.1 Wet open overheid (Woo).

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division had no remarks on the draft bill amending the Medical Devices Act to implement EU Regulation 2024/1860 on notification duties for supply interruptions and discontinuations, and advised submitting it to the House of Representatives. The minister's reply reports a clarifying amendment making explicit that information from notifications by manufacturers in other member states is also publicly disclosed, plus minor editorial changes.

36777.s: The bill strengthens school safety policy in primary, special and secondary education and the expertise centres by imposing duties on school boards: an expanded reporting, consultation and criminal-complaint duty for sexual misconduct, mandatory registration and reporting of safety incidents, mandatory confidential advisers, national complaints committees, and an annual evaluation of safety policy. It also requires periodic evaluation reports to parliament, and the explanatory memorandum addresses supervision by the Inspectorate and the coordinated role of the national complaints committees.
36777.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed to set detailed technical rules for monitoring and complaint committees, and the new duties as necessary to secure a safe school climate under the constitutional education-freedom limits.
q: The aim of this bill is to strengthen schools' safety policy by imposing clear frameworks on that policy.
Het doel van dit wetsvoorstel is om het veiligheidsbeleid van scholen te versterken door middel van het opleggen van heldere kaders ten aanzien van dat veiligheidsbeleid.
d: rules on the school safety monitor (content, target group, frequency, sending results to the inspectorate)
rules on national complaints committees (member expertise, complaint handling)
minister's general directions to committee-holding legal persons and power to withdraw designation
p: Artikel I, F (Art. 14c, lid 8-9 WPO) and parallel provisions
The minister may give general directions to, and withdraw the designation of, the legal persons that maintain national complaints committees, a supervisory role over the complaints bodies.
Artikel I, B (Art. 4a lid 2-4 WPO) and Artikel II, B
School boards must consult the inspectorate's confidential inspector before deciding on a criminal complaint, a consultation check on the school's own discretion.

parties: Asks the government to respond to the Raad van State's criticism on proportionality and effectiveness, and to clarify definitions, the position of promovendi, and whether complaints committees and the Nationale ombudsman give adequate protection.

The Council of State states that it is currently unclear to what extent these measures will actually contribute to a safer school environment and whether the measures are proportionate to the administrative burden they entail.

De Raad van State stelt dat het nu te onduidelijk is in hoeverre deze maatregelen daadwerkelijk gaan bijdragen aan een veiligere schoolomgeving en of de maatregelen wel in verhouding staan met de hoeveelheid administratieve lasten die er tegenover staan.
Supports the aim of safe schools but asks how the reporting duty avoids a box-ticking culture and how the balance between protecting vulnerable students and respecting adult autonomy is struck.
However, these members ask how it is prevented that the registration and reporting duty leads to an increase in administrative burden and bureaucratic pressure on schools.
Wel vragen deze leden hoe wordt voorkomen dat de registratie- en meldplicht leidt tot een toename van administratieve lasten en bureaucratische druk op scholen.

Worries about administrative burden, fragmentation of safety legislation, and interference with the constitutional freedom of education (art. 23 Grondwet), and questions the risk that incidents go unreported.
In addition, the NSC members are concerned about the fragmentation of safety legislation and new requirements facing schools and the restriction of constitutional article 23 by both laws.
Daarnaast maken de leden van de NSC-fractie zich zorgen over de versnippering van veiligheidswetgeving en nieuwe eisen die op scholen afkomt en de inperking van grondwetsartikel 23 van beide wetten.
Asks for explicit justification of each measure's policy goals, measurable effects, and evidence that registration leads to improved safety rather than paper compliance.
They note that the government summarily motivates the relationship between in particular the registration and reporting duty for safety incidents and improvements in safety at schools.
Zij merken op dat de regering de relatie tussen met name de registratie- en meldplicht van veiligheidsincidenten en verbeteringen in veiligheid op scholen summier motiveert.
Has no questions for the government on the bill.
These members have no questions for the government.
Deze leden hebben geen vragen aan de regering.
Questions whether the bill restricts school organisation too far under article 23 of the Constitution and whether proportionality is demonstrated, and asks why existing law was not adjusted instead.
Does the government think it still leaves enough room for schools to fill in safety policy?
Vindt de regering dat ze nog voldoende ruimte aan scholen geeft om het veiligheidsbeleid in te vullen?

Doubts the effectiveness of the measures relative to added administrative burden and prefers a culture-change approach; notes the Raad van State's warning about avoidance and over-caution in reporting.

The SP members recognise the importance of a safe school environment for everyone, but have concerns about the effectiveness of the proposed measures relative to the additional administrative burden on schools and about the chosen legal approach rather than an approach aimed at a culture change.

De leden van de SP-fractie onderkennen het belang van een veilige schoolomgeving voor iedereen, maar hebben zorgen over de doeltreffendheid van de voorgestelde maatregelen in verhouding tot de extra administratieve last die deze bij scholen leggen en over de gekozen juridische aanpak in plaats van een aanpak gericht op een cultuuromslag.

Argues the bill goes beyond the school's responsibility, intrudes on the competent authority's (bevoegd gezag) discretion, and reduces school freedom; questions proportionality and asks for justification of a mandatory annual evaluation and national complaints committees.
The SGP members note that the government gives only marginal account of the need for proportionality of measures.
De leden van de SGP-fractie constateren dat de regering slechts marginaal rekenschap geeft van de noodzaak van proportionaliteit van maatregelen.

Notes the bill restricts educational freedom and adds administrative burden, questions whether rules improve safety, asks whether alternatives were considered, and worries that mandatory compliance with complaints committee rulings juridifies relations and limits school boards' room to act.
The proposal creates considerable additional administrative burdens for schools and constitutes a restriction on educational freedom.
Het voorstel zorgt immers voor flinke extra administratieve lasten voor scholen en vormt een inperking op de onderwijsvrijheid.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the Wet vrij en veilig onderwijs, criticising that the school safety measures focus on administration and procedures without showing effectiveness for school culture, lack proportionality justification, overlap with the Arbeidsomstandighedenwet, and that extending reporting duties to adults and data processing need reconsideration. The government's reply accepts several points, such as dropping the staff safety monitor, the reporting of incidents involving staff, and the aangifteplicht for adults, while defending the other measures and adding justifications and data safeguards.
concerns: The Afdeling says the measures do not show how they effectively contribute to a safe school culture and may have counterproductive effects on open dialogue; the government defends them as a basic norm and adds per-measure justification.

The Afdeling asks for per-measure substantive justification of proportionality, including against freedom of school organisation and regulatory burden; the government adds justification in the memorie van toelichting.

The Afdeling advises removing the staff safety monitor and the reporting of serious incidents involving staff to avoid overlap with Arbowetgeving and dual supervision; the government drops the staff monitor and keeps incident reporting only as justified for serious cases.

The Afdeling flags duplicate rules on confidential advisers and complaints procedures alongside the pending Maatoug initiative bill; the government aligns the school rules with that bill and avoids duplicate regulation.

The Afdeling asks for statutory safeguards for processing special and criminal-law personal data, including retention periods and access limits; the government adds retention periods and access restrictions in the bill.

The Afdeling asks for reasoned justification of extending reporting and aangifte duties to adult students given victim autonomy; the government drops the aangifteplicht for adults but keeps the meld- and overlegplicht.

The Afdeling notes that the confidential adviser's duty of secrecy restricts data subjects' rights of objection under the GDPR; the government responds by explaining this limitation is acceptable and adds clarification.

36786.s: The bill amends the 2025 budget of the Ministry of Economic Affairs by adding 270 million euros in new commitments and expenditure under business support, specifically loans for business support, via a second incidental supplementary budget. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from 8 July 2025, with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad appears later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs (XIII) for the year 2025
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken (XIII) voor het jaar 2025

36850-III.s: This bill amends the 2025 budget statements (second supplementary budget) for the Ministry of General Affairs, the Cabinet of the King, and the Review Committee on the Intelligence and Security Services (CTIVD). It increases the General Affairs budget by a net amount, reduces the Cabinet of the King's budget by one thousand euros, and reduces the CTIVD budget by 500 thousand euros due to underspending.
q: Underspending at the Review Committee on the Intelligence and Security Services (CTIVD).
Onderuitputting bij de Commissie van Toezicht op de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten (CTIVD).

36858.s: The bill amends the 2025 departmental budget statement of the Defence Materiel Budget Fund by reallocating commitments, expenditure and revenue across defence materiel categories, in thousands of euros. It sets the bill's entry into force retroactively to 19 November 2025 and orders publication in the Staatsblad.
q: the need has emerged for an amendment to the departmental budget statement of the Defence Materiel Budget Fund (K) for the year 2025
de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Defensiematerieelbegrotingsfonds (K), voor het jaar 2025

36867.s: The bill increases the number of members of the island councils of Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba and of the executive councillors (eilandgedeputeerden), with the council size later tied to population figures. It also adds leave rules for pregnancy, illness and part-time executive functions, with decisions on leave not open to appeal.
36867.j: The memorandum justifies excluding appeal by the time an appeal procedure takes, the risk of questioning illness or pregnancy, and the bound nature of the decision.
q: No appeal can be lodged against the decision on the leave request.
Tegen de beslissing op het verzoek tot verlof kan geen beroep worden ingesteld.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel F (artikel 56b, derde lid)
leave decisions by the executive college
p: Artikel I, onderdeel F (artikel 56b, derde lid)
Decisions on leave requests cannot be challenged through objection or appeal, though the decision must follow the medical advice given.
Artikel IV, onderdeel A (artikel 1, derde en vierde lid)
Council size is tied to population figures published by the statistics bureau, with a fixed reference date.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the government justify why raising the number of island council members and executive councillors should be prioritised ahead of other measures to strengthen island governance, why the public bodies were not consulted on this prioritisation, and why Sint Eustatius should be exempt from the evaluation step. The government's reply argues the change is needed regardless of the broader reform, that the public bodies agreed to it at a 2024 working conference, and that the explanatory memorandum has been supplemented.
concerns: The Afdeling found insufficient justification for prioritising the increase in island council seats before other measures to strengthen island governance; the government justified it in the memorandum and supplemented it with the link to the broader reform.

The Afdeling noted the public bodies' involvement in the choice to prioritise the bill was not addressed; the government acknowledged no formal consultation but pointed to a 2024 working conference and a bestuurlijk overleg.

The Afdeling asked for justification of the deviating procedure for Sint Eustatius, lacking an evaluation step, or otherwise an evaluation; the government declined, citing the island board's wishes and the option to evaluate later.

36876.s: The bill amends the Dutch Criminal Code and the Economic Offences Act to implement the 2024 EU directive on criminal protection of the environment, adding new environmental offences with higher maximum penalties, including life imprisonment for the gravest cases. It also raises the maximum penalty for death by negligence and extends the scope of the Economic Offences Act to cover the new offences.
36876.j: The memorandum justifies the new penalties by the EU directive's requirements and notes that Member States may rely on general provisions on intentional homicide and gross negligence, with courts retaining wide sentencing discretion.
q: Recital 30 of the directive expressly states that Member States must be able to rely on general provisions on 'intentional homicide and manslaughter by gross negligence' when implementing the maximum penalties prescribed by the directive.

In overweging 30 bij de richtlijn staat immers uitdrukkelijk dat lidstaten een beroep moeten kunnen doen op algemene bepalingen over «opzettelijke doodslag en doodslag door grove nalatigheid» bij de implementatie van de door de richtlijn voorgeschreven strafmaxima.

parties: Raises the low chance of detection and weak supervision, and asks how the Court of Audit's findings on poor information-sharing and enforcement will be addressed.

In doing so, the members speaking are mainly concerned about the (too low) chance of being caught, the shortcomings of supervision and enforcement, and practical obstacles to prosecuting environmental crime.

Daarbij hebben de aan het woord zijnde leden voornamelijk zorgen over de (te lage) pakkans, het tekortschieten van toezicht en handhaving en praktische belemmeringen bij het bestraffen van milieucriminaliteit.
Asks for limitative examples and guidance for open terms such as significant harm and gross negligence, and whether the threshold for liability is set too high.
Is the government willing to include concrete, limitative examples of these terms?
Is de regering bereid concrete, limitatieve voorbeelden op te nemen van deze begrippen?
Asks whether preventive measures and adequate staffing and budgets for enforcement bodies will be provided under the directive.
Will the currently available number of full-time equivalents, for example, suffice, or must considerably more expertise be appointed?
Gaat het thans beschikbare aantal voltijdsequivalenten (fte) bijvoorbeeld volstaan, of moet aanmerkelijk méér expertise worden aangesteld?
Asks how open concepts such as long-term and widespread harm are guaranteed to meet the lex certa principle and avoid legal uncertainty.
How does the government ensure that these open norms comply with the lex certa principle and do not in practice lead to legal uncertainty or divergent application?
Hoe waarborgt de regering dat deze open normen voldoen aan het lex-certa-beginsel en in de praktijk niet leiden tot rechtsonzekerheid of uiteenlopende toepassing?
Criticises the broad extension of criminal liability to environment as a standalone legal interest and the wide discretion left to investigators and courts, raising legal certainty concerns.
Terms such as 'significant' and 'destructive' environmental damage are by definition context-dependent and leave considerable room for judgement to investigation and the judiciary.
Begrippen als «aanzienlijke» en «vernietigende» milieuschade zijn per definitie contextafhankelijk en laten veel beoordelingsruimte over aan opsporing en rechterlijke macht.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised sharpening the explanatory memorandum on three points: justifying the general increase of the maximum penalty for dood door schuld in the form of roekeloosheid beyond environmental offences, clarifying the open term 'langdurig', and addressing enforcement capacity for environmental crime. The minister's reply states the memorandum was supplemented on all three points, explaining the penalty consistency rationale, that 'langdurig' depends on ecosystem type, and describing enforcement investments and capacity.
concerns: The Afdeling asks how raising the maximum penalty for dood door schuld in the form of roekeloosheid, applying beyond environmental offences, relates to the nature and seriousness of the offence; the reply adds justification in the memorandum.
The open term 'langdurig' lacks clarity for citizens and legal practice; the Afdeling advises explaining its meaning, and the memorandum was supplemented accordingly.

The Afdeling advises explaining how enforcement and supervision capacity will be boosted to make the new environmental criminal law effective; the memorandum was supplemented with budget and capacity information.

36885.s: The bill implements EU Directive 2024/1619 and Directive 2024/2994 by amending the Wft to tighten prudential supervision of banks and investment firms: new fit-and-proper rules for key staff, ESG risk management, harmonised supervisory sanctions, a new licensing and classification regime for third-country branches, and expanded DNB powers over prudential transactions and branch capital. Most of the changes are mandated by the EU directives, with DNB given wide discretion to impose measures on third-country branches and to classify and designate entities.
36885.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and new supervisory powers by the directive's harmonisation aims, the need to close regulatory gaps for third-country branches, and the lack of uniform supervisory tools across member states.
q: The purpose of this is that the supervisory authorities concerned coordinate their assessments and ensure the consistency of their decisions.
Het doel hiervan is dat de betrokken toezichthouders hun beoordelingen coördineren en de consistentie van hun beslissingen waarborgen.
d: DNB measures on higher capital, restrictions and reporting for branches
DNB may require third-country branches to apply for a full banking licence
further rules on suitability of key staff
information to be provided with notifications of divestment or transfer
reporting data and conditions for changes by classes 1 and 2 branches
DNB sets additional governance requirements and frequency of independent review of branches
p: DNB may require third-country branches above size thresholds to obtain a full banking licence, based on its own assessment of supervisory problems.
DNB can impose capital, liquidity, business restriction and disclosure measures on branches where it considers risks are not adequately managed.

parties: Asks why transposition is late, whether the EU Commission infringement risk is managed, and how ESG supervision stays proportionate and consistent across member states.
These members ask the government to explain the cause of missing the implementation deadline and the state of play with the European Commission regarding an infringement procedure.
Deze leden vragen de regering om nader toe te lichten wat de oorzaak is van het niet tijdig halen van de implementatietermijn
Asks about the infringement risk from late transposition, which Basel III countries have implemented, and why national options are used or not in line with the coalition agreement.
According to the government, is the use of this member state option a national gold-plating? If not, why not?
Is het gebruik van deze lidstaatoptie volgens de regering een nationale kop? Zo nee, waarom niet?
Asks about the effect of late transposition and the impact on mortgage capital and rates if the temporary low-risk mortgage option expires.
Is there contact with the European Commission about this, so as to prevent an infringement procedure?
Is hierover contact met de Europese Commissie om zodoende een inbreukprocedure te voorkomen?
Questions the value and scope of ESG obligations for banks and whether banks can break existing contracts retroactively, and objects to the compliance burden and costs.
These members want to know what added value this has.
Deze leden willen weten wat voor toegevoegde waarde dit heeft.
Objects to treating fossil fuel use as credit risk, calls this a political choice, and asks for separate reporting of ESG effects in credit decisions and a limit on ESG requirements.
Does the government share the FVD members' view that classifying fossil energy use as an ESG risk is a political choice rather than an objective risk analysis?
Deelt de regering de mening van de leden van de FVD-fractie dat de kwalificatie van fossiel energiegebruik als ESG-risico een politieke keuze is en geen objectieve risicoanalyse?
Critical of expanded ESG requirements, arguing they add administrative burden and may cause banks to withdraw finance from non-green sectors such as heavy industry and agriculture.
Now that banks are required to weigh ESG risks more heavily, these members see the risk that they withdraw financing from sectors that are not yet 'green'.
Nu banken verplicht worden ESG-risico's zwaarder mee te wegen, bestaat wat deze leden betreft het risico dat zij hun financiering terugtrekken uit sectoren die momenteel nog niet «groen» zijn
Asks what risk analysis supports the third-country branch regime, how avoidance of stricter supervision via branches is prevented, and why the penalty payment maximum is not raised.
How is it prevented that banking activities are placed in branches to avoid stricter supervision?
Hoe wordt voorkomen dat bankactiviteiten via bijkantoren worden ondergebracht om zwaarder toezicht te ontwijken?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the Implementatiewet kapitaalvereisten 2026, which transposes EU directives on bank capital requirements and exposures to central counterparties, and raised no remarks. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport reports minor technical and editorial amendments, clarifications on fit-and-proper rules, third-country branch exemptions and transitional phasing-out, but no substantive objections are addressed.

36939.s: The bill amends several BES tax laws for 2027, including allowing a fiscal unity for general consumption tax, expanding collection powers (postal service of collection orders, stopping vehicles, a renewed payment order), a wage-tax change on company cars, and an adjusted fine provision. It also raises the VAT-like rate, adjusts the tax-free allowance link to the minimum wage, and makes technical corrections.
36939.j: The memorandum justifies the stop-vehicle and postal-service powers as needed to make tax collection effective and to keep taxpayers' legal protection intact.
q: The cabinet considers it desirable to give the Tax Authority the statutory power to stop vehicles in order to collect tax assessments.
Het kabinet vindt het wenselijk om de Belastingdienst de wettelijke bevoegdheid te geven voertuigen staande te houden om belastingaanslagen te innen.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel B (artikel 6.8a, derde lid, Belastingwet BES)
formation, change and termination of fiscal unity for consumption tax
Artikel III, onderdeel A (artikel 6d, zesde lid, Wet loonbelasting BES)
annual replacement of the tax-free amount by ministerial regulation
Artikel III, onderdeel B (artikel 20, onderdeel b, Wet loonbelasting BES)
rules on designating company car benefit as final-levy component
Artikel I, onderdeel I (artikel 8.48b, vijfde lid, Belastingwet BES)
amount above which judicial custody of seized goods is assumed
p: Artikel I, onderdeel I (artikel 8.48b, eerste lid, Belastingwet BES)
Tax officials and police may order a driver to stop a vehicle to enforce a collection order, including at any hour, against the registered holder's vehicle.
Artikel I, onderdeel H (artikel 8.48, tweede en derde lid, Belastingwet BES)
Collection orders may be served by post, with a deemed-service rule, and not where the collector learns the notice did not arrive or where accelerated collection applies.
Artikel I, onderdeel B (artikel 6.8a, tweede lid, Belastingwet BES)
Inspector decides fiscal unity requests by appealable decision, preserving an administrative remedy.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the Fiscale verzamelwet BES eilanden 2027 can proceed to the Tweede Kamer without any remarks. The State Secretary's nader rapport notes the advice gives no reason for further comment and records technical changes, including dropping the minor-children wage attribution provision and adding a retroactive correction of a wrong reference in the Douane- en Accijnswet BES.

36948.s: The bill adds paragraphs 4 to 7 to article 151a of the Municipalities Act, allowing municipalities by ordinance to permit processing of special personal data (race or ethnic origin, health, sexual behaviour) of sex workers where needed to enforce and supervise rules on sex businesses. It requires retention limits of at most seven years, specific safeguards such as access authorisation, access logging and five-yearly data protection audits, and security measures for operators.
36948.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation as the only way to make the processing needed to enforce the existing sex-business rules, and says the statute sets the core limits while safeguards answer Council of State and Dutch Data Protection Authority advice.
q: Because creating this power is the only way to make this data processing possible and so give effect to the above rules, no alternatives to solving this problem were considered.

Omdat het creëren van deze bevoegdheid de enige mogelijkheid is om deze gegevensverwerking mogelijk te maken en daarmee de bovengenoemde voorschriften te effectueren, zijn er geen alternatieven voor de oplossing van dit probleem overwogen.
d: ordinance permitting processing of special personal data for enforcement of sex business rules
retention and destruction period set by ordinance within seven-year maximum
specific safeguards for processing by municipalities set by ordinance
p: Municipal councils gain power to override the statutory ban on processing special personal data of sex workers by ordinance, with the statute itself setting the outer limits of purpose, retention and safeguards.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill creating a statutory basis for municipalities and sex businesses to process special personal data of sex workers to enforce municipal regulations on sex businesses, raising concerns about municipal autonomy in limiting privacy rights under Article 10 of the Constitution and about safeguards and the retention period. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepted the main remarks, clarifying municipal autonomy, adding statutory safeguards, and setting a fixed retention limit of seven years after the first processing.
concerns: Municipal autonomy cannot justify limiting the privacy right under Article 10 of the Constitution; the explanatory memorandum was amended accordingly.
Essential safeguards for processing sensitive personal data should be set in the statute itself, including measures for exploitants, to protect privacy and legal certainty.
The retention period must be objectively fixed in law rather than depending on the controller's later processing actions.
The information duty and security obligations under the GDPR are already mandatory and cannot count as additional specific safeguards.

36957.s: The bill amends the Dutch Pensioenwet, the Wet verplichte beroepspensioenregeling and the Wet op de loonbelasting 1964 to implement commitments under the Wtp, including voluntary continuation of survivor's pensions, a uniform child definition including stepchildren and foster children, extended continuation of pensions during incapacity for work, and continuation of risk-based survivor cover after private unemployment benefits. It also makes technical corrections and allows the executive to set transitional and implementation rules by general administrative order.
36957.j: The memorandum justifies the administrative-decree powers on grounds of implementation and technical consistency with the Wtp transition rules, without detailed reasoning on parliamentary control.
